0ezjtqx.raw: 'Low water. Look at all that sand. Nothing\'s coming to take any of it.'
0ezjtqx.text: Low water. Look at all that sand. Nothing's coming to take any of it.

1acmx3v.text: High water. KEEP THE SEA's under the sea now. Only one out here that got what it asked for.

04g4vvj.text: I read 'em, that's all I do. First word's always KEEP. After THE it gets tricky.

0vcpcpb.text: Old ones are neat and small. New ones are huge. Hurts my neck, honestly.

0h0yb4h.text: {score}! Clean night. I'll write that on a label. A small one, not like theirs.

0dgb0at.text: {score}. Watch the holes. They always pick the same holes.

19b7dpx.raw: 'Nope. Not coming out. Not at dead low, and not for just anybody.'
19b7dpx.text: Nope. Not coming out. Not at dead low, and not for just anybody.

0fu0jes.raw: 'I never stay in the same shell. Never skip past one, either. Always next door.'
0fu0jes.text: I never stay in the same shell. Never skip past one, either. Always next door.

14b0z1l.raw: 'And I don\'t grab a shell I haven\'t had my ear on first.'
14b0z1l.text: And I don't grab a shell I haven't had my ear on first.

1fiaiwn.text: (Put your ear to a shell to listen. An empty shell plays with notes missing.)

0sr6yz8.raw: '(A shell with someone moving in it plays with footsteps in it.)'
0sr6yz8.text: (A shell with someone moving in it plays with footsteps in it.)

0s0pa76.text: Huh. Don't usually lose that one. Don't mind, though. Much.

1e1k58d.raw: 'Rules, if you\'re sticking round. No labeled ones. No standing up at dead low.'
1e1k58d.text: Rules, if you're sticking round. No labeled ones. No standing up at dead low.

0j7wr6c.raw: 'And I never look up at it. Don\'t need to. You learn the feet, you don\'t forget the feet.'
0j7wr6c.text: And I never look up at it. Don't need to. You learn the feet, you don't forget the feet.

1pisapb.raw: 'Look at the big square in the middle of the Tray.'
1pisapb.text: Look at the big square in the middle of the Tray.

0wposod.text: The posts are white and round on top. They are as tall as the posts at the corners of the Margin.

0uergi9.raw: 'I stay off the big square. Never seen a thing in it. Not once.'
0uergi9.text: I stay off the big square. Never seen a thing in it. Not once.

1cwa69k.raw: 'Listened down every row. Once. Not doing it twice. Not one whole tune in the lot.'
1cwa69k.text: Listened down every row. Once. Not doing it twice. Not one whole tune in the lot.

0e3we77.raw: 'Never heard one play the whole thing. Except yours, way up the beach.'
0e3we77.text: Never heard one play the whole thing. Except yours, way up the beach.

0nvdxcm.text: Stand by the big empty square.

0ijqyim.raw: 'Labeled. I wouldn\'t. Wouldn\'t stop you, though.'
0ijqyim.text: Labeled. I wouldn't. Wouldn't stop you, though.

0g0xeml.text: Here. I don't keep keys I can't use. Opens the last room in the top one.

09nyqys.text: Told you. No labeled ones. No standing up at dead low.

0vgheyo.text: Big square's in the middle. Go look. I'm not going near it.

1t5i7tv.raw: 'Sit. Wade, huh. That\'s a name for somebody small.'

0f8trjd.text: Seen that before. Left one at a post myself. Did the same thing every day.

15dkcs9.text: (With the tide table, a mark shows where the next foot lands.)

06pdgfs.text: Don't fight fair. Don't fight long. Get down here.

06y72q1.text: Keep it. Never keep what I win anyway.

0n0sr7e.text: There. Don't give these out much. Don't have much to give.

0o5dj1l.text: Stand by the big empty square.

0x2dezb.text: Listen at the big empty square.

09v7vlp.text: In the square the ground is crazed all over.

0gcmixd.text: In the middle is a shell-shaped hollow, and nothing in it.

171qgy3.text: A cart with its shafts down. Nothing is between the shafts.

1yf3bri.text: A row of washing over a wall, dry for years. It does not move.

0lbti28.text: A door with a lock. Every other door here opens for stillness. This one wants a key.

1tqabxp.text: (Doors here open only when nothing moves near them.)

1k8mg5b.text: The flat round place, crazed all over. Through the crazes, far below, the Tray's rows.

0g805z5.text: Sit. That's me, there. Still at it.

1tp884p.raw: 'There. Both of us sitting. Only took forty years.'
1tp884p.text: There. Both of us sitting. Only took forty years.

1rhqkjj.text: Sit and watch me a while. Funny. Never stops, does it.

1ew7x78.text: Sit down by me, then. You've stood long enough.

0eocihh.raw: 'Four. W, A, D, E. Still four. Only count I\'ve ever been sure of.'
0eocihh.text: Four. W, A, D, E. Still four. Only count I've ever been sure of.

0djz2uj.text: Four. Letters, I think, in the shine on the far knuckle. Can't read backward, me.

0db3j2h.text: One. Star, that's what it takes. Maybe two. Stand on the far knuckle at night and wait.

0qdxlay.text: It shines now! Forty years of rubbing, and look at it go :-]

0vrqv60.text: When a star falls at night, it shines right across to the far knuckle. All the way!

18vb9b8.text: Mind the shine on your way out. It gets in your eyes, the good way.

067ouma.text: Four. W, A, D, E. Four, and I'm sure. Had the ring down as a knuckle for years. It's a name.

1tj7k4z.text: I dive in the mouth at low, while it's out walking. Pearls in there! Big pink ones.

09ie1g1.text: Letters pressed into the pink of the lip itself.

1xmq3j5.text: Something has held this shell, often, by the knobs.

1wgfrsz.text: Under the lip's edge, where the pink curls back, a nautilus horn.

0j9ne7j.text: A label stuck in the sand by the great pink shell.

19a66c5.text: Wade. Been saying it over. Small sort of name.

0vv9mts.text: Lip's still good. Haven't moved off it once. Plenty of room.

0ob984x.raw: 'Many texts use the sign %. It means out of 100. 50% is half. 25% is one quarter. 10% is one tenth.'
0ob984x.text: Many texts use the sign %. It means out of 100. 50% is half. 25% is one quarter. 10% is one tenth.

19dy71e.raw: 'Each whorl has a plain Attack. It is physical or magic. A physical Attack uses ATK. A magic Attack uses MGK.'
19dy71e.text: Each whorl has a plain Attack. It is physical or magic. A physical Attack uses ATK. A magic Attack uses MGK.

1ee5vmn.raw: 'A move\'s text tells you which stat it uses. Hits for 110% ATK is a physical hit. Hits for 90% MGK is a magic hit.'
1ee5vmn.text: A move's text tells you which stat it uses. Hits for 110% ATK is a physical hit. Hits for 90% MGK is a magic hit.

1iwboyb.raw: 'DEF and RES make a hit smaller. Say a hit has 100 power. It does 70 damage to a whorl with 42 DEF. It does 50 damage to a whorl with 100 DEF.'
1iwboyb.text: DEF and RES make a hit smaller. Say a hit has 100 power. It does 70 damage to a whorl with 42 DEF. It does 50 damage to a whorl with 100 DEF.

17cp80e.raw: 'So DEF helps most against physical whorls. RES helps most against magic whorls.'
17cp80e.text: So DEF helps most against physical whorls. RES helps most against magic whorls.

1ed1xsh.raw: 'To see a whorl\'s stats, press X. Pick Team, then the whorl, then Look. The Stats tab shows them.'
1ed1xsh.text: To see a whorl's stats, press X. Pick Team, then the whorl, then Look. The Stats tab shows them.

01znnyc.raw: 'In a battle, whorls do not just take turns one by one. After a whorl acts, it has to wait. The whorl whose wait ends first moves next.'
01znnyc.text: In a battle, whorls do not just take turns one by one. After a whorl acts, it has to wait. The whorl whose wait ends first moves next.

1o06tce.raw: 'AGI makes the wait shorter. So a fast whorl can move twice before a slow one moves once.'
1o06tce.text: AGI makes the wait shorter. So a fast whorl can move twice before a slow one moves once.

19evhc2.raw: 'Here is an example. Your whorl has 69 AGI. The foe has 51 AGI. Your whorl moves first. Over the whole battle, it gets about 9 turns for every 8 the foe gets.'
19evhc2.text: Here is an example. Your whorl has 69 AGI. The foe has 51 AGI. Your whorl moves first. Over the whole battle, it gets about 9 turns for every 8 the foe gets.

19yzgwa.raw: 'Some actions have a short wait. After a Guard, a whorl waits 80% as long as after an Attack. After a Switch, it waits half as long.'
19yzgwa.text: Some actions have a short wait. After a Guard, a whorl waits 80% as long as after an Attack. After a Switch, it waits half as long.

13w70yp.raw: 'Slow makes a whorl wait 30% longer. Haste makes it wait 30% less.'
13w70yp.text: Slow makes a whorl wait 30% longer. Haste makes it wait 30% less.

0wfzr22.raw: 'Some texts say its next turn comes 40% sooner. This means the whorl waits less before it moves again. The wait gets about 40% shorter.'
0wfzr22.text: Some texts say its next turn comes 40% sooner. This means the whorl waits less before it moves again. The wait gets about 40% shorter.

07ae13z.raw: 'Look at the top line of the battle. It tells you when a whorl will move twice in a row.'
07ae13z.text: Look at the top line of the battle. It tells you when a whorl will move twice in a row.

1gtjpoh.raw: 'A wind-up is a move that lands later. A ! shows over a whorl while it winds up. The top line tells you how many moves you get first.'
1gtjpoh.text: A wind-up is a move that lands later. A ! shows over a whorl while it winds up. The top line tells you how many moves you get first.

14gwfcn.raw: 'You can stop a foe\'s wind-up. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Taunt cuts it off. So does forcing the foe out.'
14gwfcn.text: You can stop a foe's wind-up. Stun, Silence, Sleep, or Taunt cuts it off. So does forcing the foe out.

1oq1pi2.raw: 'You can also switch to a whorl that takes less from the move. An Unstoppable wind-up cannot be cut off.'
1oq1pi2.text: You can also switch to a whorl that takes less from the move. An Unstoppable wind-up cannot be cut off.

17nnm6m.raw: 'A round is one turn for each side. The game counts rounds in very long battles.'
17nnm6m.text: A round is one turn for each side. The game counts rounds in very long battles.

0scsx4i.raw: 'On your turn, you pick one action. You can Attack, use a move, Guard, or Switch.'
0scsx4i.text: On your turn, you pick one action. You can Attack, use a move, Guard, or Switch.

1npi0x2.raw: 'Attack is your whorl\'s plain hit. You can use it every turn. It never runs out. An Attack has no type, so it hits every type the same.'
1npi0x2.text: Attack is your whorl's plain hit. You can use it every turn. It never runs out. An Attack has no type, so it hits every type the same.

09lkib6.raw: 'Each whorl has four moves. A move hits harder, or it does something special. Before you pick a move, look at it. Its text tells you what it does.'
09lkib6.text: Each whorl has four moves. A move hits harder, or it does something special. Before you pick a move, look at it. Its text tells you what it does.

0wnb13w.raw: 'The text is short. Hits for 110% ATK means a hit with 1.1 times the whorl\'s ATK. Slow 1 means the foe is slowed for 1 turn.'
0wnb13w.text: The text is short. Hits for 110% ATK means a hit with 1.1 times the whorl's ATK. Slow 1 means the foe is slowed for 1 turn.

0jmf5wv.raw: 'After you use a move, it has to rest. The rest is its cooldown. The menu shows how many turns are left.'
0jmf5wv.text: After you use a move, it has to rest. The rest is its cooldown. The menu shows how many turns are left.

11qui76.raw: 'Here is an example. Flatten has a cooldown of 3. Squall uses Flatten. Then Flatten rests for Squall\'s next 3 turns. On the 4th turn, it is ready again.'
11qui76.text: Here is an example. Flatten has a cooldown of 3. Squall uses Flatten. Then Flatten rests for Squall's next 3 turns. On the 4th turn, it is ready again.

0m2r4c3.raw: 'A cooldown counts your side\'s turns. It keeps going down while the whorl waits in reserve.'
0m2r4c3.text: A cooldown counts your side's turns. It keeps going down while the whorl waits in reserve.

1titfc5.raw: 'A move of the whorl\'s own type hits 20% harder. Squall is a TIDE whorl. So its TIDE moves hit 20% harder.'
1titfc5.text: A move of the whorl's own type hits 20% harder. Squall is a TIDE whorl. So its TIDE moves hit 20% harder.

0nu9crm.raw: 'Some moves hit every foe. The out foe takes the full hit. Each foe in reserve takes a smaller part. It is often about one third.'
0nu9crm.text: Some moves hit every foe. The out foe takes the full hit. Each foe in reserve takes a smaller part. It is often about one third.

01dyhnt.raw: 'Guard cuts the damage your whorl takes in half. It lasts until your whorl\'s next turn.'
01dyhnt.text: Guard cuts the damage your whorl takes in half. It lasts until your whorl's next turn.

1asdj8v.raw: 'You cannot Guard two turns in a row. A Guard is quick, too.'
1asdj8v.text: You cannot Guard two turns in a row. A Guard is quick, too.

1cj10qw.raw: 'Each whorl has two habits. A habit works by itself. You do not pick it. In a battle, press left or right on the menu to read the habits.'
1cj10qw.text: Each whorl has two habits. A habit works by itself. You do not pick it. In a battle, press left or right on the menu to read the habits.

147xbph.raw: 'A crest is a whorl\'s biggest move. Most whorls have one crest. A crest costs tide.'
147xbph.text: A crest is a whorl's biggest move. Most whorls have one crest. A crest costs tide.

1hnm0ky.raw: `Tide is a pool that your whole team shares. It holds up to ${NERVE_MAX}. It starts each battle at 2.`
1hnm0ky.text: Tide is a pool that your whole team shares. It holds up to {NERVE_MAX}. It starts each battle at 2.

1685alc.text: An Attack that lands adds 1 tide.

1yj3p8i.raw: 'When a move hits a whorl that guards, its side gets 1 tide. This works once for each Guard.'
1yj3p8i.text: When a move hits a whorl that guards, its side gets 1 tide. This works once for each Guard.

0f8zva8.raw: 'When you knock out a foe, you get 2 tide.'
0f8zva8.text: When you knock out a foe, you get 2 tide.

0ru6dmx.raw: 'When one of your whorls is knocked out, you get 1 tide.'
0ru6dmx.text: When one of your whorls is knocked out, you get 1 tide.

066qvt6.raw: 'Some moves, habits, and notions add tide too.'
066qvt6.text: Some moves, habits, and notions add tide too.

1ijkri7.raw: 'Here is an example. Cloudburst is Squall\'s crest. It costs 5 tide. You start with 2. Land 3 Attacks, and you have 5.'
1ijkri7.text: Here is an example. Cloudburst is Squall's crest. It costs 5 tide. You start with 2. Land 3 Attacks, and you have 5.

1pq8k3u.raw: 'The foe has its own pool of tide. Watch it. When it is full, a crest may come.'
1pq8k3u.text: The foe has its own pool of tide. Watch it. When it is full, a crest may come.

0pf1og7.raw: 'A crest has a cooldown too, like any other move.'
0pf1og7.text: A crest has a cooldown too, like any other move.

0c5u9tq.raw: 'Every whorl has one or two types. Every move has one type. Types decide who is strong against whom.'
0c5u9tq.text: Every whorl has one or two types. Every move has one type. Types decide who is strong against whom.

1dv0vtm.raw: 'There are six types. They are STONE, TIDE, ROOT, GEAR, BEAST, and STAR.'
1dv0vtm.text: There are six types. They are STONE, TIDE, ROOT, GEAR, BEAST, and STAR.

0zjsmee.raw: 'Each row is the type of a move. Each column is the type of the foe. A plus means the move is strong. A minus means it is weak.'
0zjsmee.text: Each row is the type of a move. Each column is the type of the foe. A plus means the move is strong. A minus means it is weak.

0qmfzxp.raw: 'A strong hit does 1.5 times the damage. A weak hit does about two thirds of it.'
0qmfzxp.text: A strong hit does 1.5 times the damage. A weak hit does about two thirds of it.

0cby41l.raw: 'Here is an example. TIDE is strong against STONE. Squall\'s Rain Shot hits Kivishi 1.5 times as hard. STONE is weak against TIDE. Kivishi\'s STONE moves do two thirds on Squall.'
0cby41l.text: Here is an example. TIDE is strong against STONE. Squall's Rain Shot hits Kivishi 1.5 times as hard. STONE is weak against TIDE. Kivishi's STONE moves do two thirds on Squall.

1s807y8.raw: 'A whorl with two types counts both. If both are weak to a move, it hits 2 times as hard. A strong one and a weak one cancel out. A hit never does more than 2 times, or less than half.'
1s807y8.text: A whorl with two types counts both. If both are weak to a move, it hits 2 times as hard. A strong one and a weak one cancel out. A hit never does more than 2 times, or less than half.

0vt0rpj.raw: 'When a hit lands, the battle shows strong or weak. Before you pick a move, look at it. It tells you when the foe is weak to it.'
0vt0rpj.text: When a hit lands, the battle shows strong or weak. Before you pick a move, look at it. It tells you when the foe is weak to it.

0o47oco.raw: 'A plain Attack has no type. Damage from statuses has no type either.'
0o47oco.text: A plain Attack has no type. Damage from statuses has no type either.

091bicn.raw: 'A status is a short effect on a whorl. It shows as a small icon by the whorl\'s HP bar.'
091bicn.text: A status is a short effect on a whorl. It shows as a small icon by the whorl's HP bar.

1e4dic6.raw: 'The number after a status is how many turns it lasts. Slow 2 lasts for 2 of the whorl\'s own turns. For Bleed and Poison, the number is how many stacks there are.'
1e4dic6.text: The number after a status is how many turns it lasts. Slow 2 lasts for 2 of the whorl's own turns. For Bleed and Poison, the number is how many stacks there are.

0rsroe7.raw: 'Stun. The whorl loses its next turn. A stun also cuts off a wind-up.'
0rsroe7.text: Stun. The whorl loses its next turn. A stun also cuts off a wind-up.

1m539a0.raw: 'Sleep. The whorl loses its turns. A hit wakes it up.'
1m539a0.text: Sleep. The whorl loses its turns. A hit wakes it up.

1ljngr8.raw: 'Silence. The whorl cannot use moves. It can still Attack, Guard, or Switch.'
1ljngr8.text: Silence. The whorl cannot use moves. It can still Attack, Guard, or Switch.

1j8jsw2.text: Taunt. The whorl can only Attack.

1yfkv0f.text: Root. The whorl cannot switch out.

0fk1b50.raw: 'Slow. The whorl waits 30% longer between turns.'
0fk1b50.text: Slow. The whorl waits 30% longer between turns.

1uno12e.raw: 'Burn. The whorl takes magic damage at the start of each turn.'
1uno12e.text: Burn. The whorl takes magic damage at the start of each turn.

1kcoe0z.raw: 'Bleed. The whorl takes physical damage at the start of each turn. Then it loses one stack.'
1kcoe0z.text: Bleed. The whorl takes physical damage at the start of each turn. Then it loses one stack.

1fvrpvc.raw: 'Poison. The whorl loses 3% of its max HP for each stack at the start of each turn. Then it loses one stack.'
1fvrpvc.text: Poison. The whorl loses 3% of its max HP for each stack at the start of each turn. Then it loses one stack.

1wn047m.raw: 'Rot. Healing on the whorl is cut in half.'
1wn047m.text: Rot. Healing on the whorl is cut in half.

0fak9tc.text: Expose. The whorl takes 25% more damage.

0h50yme.text: Weaken. The whorl deals 25% less damage.

0ylzbw6.raw: 'Doom. The whorl takes damage each turn. It cannot heal or use moves.'
0ylzbw6.text: Doom. The whorl takes damage each turn. It cannot heal or use moves.

0ejrh5e.raw: 'Haste. The whorl waits 30% less between turns.'
0ejrh5e.text: Haste. The whorl waits 30% less between turns.

1w0o932.text: Empower. The whorl deals 25% more damage.

16f0pdb.text: Fortify. The whorl takes 25% less damage.

1ifmu9q.raw: 'Regen. The whorl heals a little at the start of each turn.'
1ifmu9q.text: Regen. The whorl heals a little at the start of each turn.

0h3e0h2.raw: 'Ward. It stops the next move a foe uses on the whorl. If nothing comes, it fades after 2 turns.'
0h3e0h2.text: Ward. It stops the next move a foe uses on the whorl. If nothing comes, it fades after 2 turns.

1tvcv88.raw: 'Thorns. When the whorl is hit, it hits back for part of the damage.'
1tvcv88.text: Thorns. When the whorl is hit, it hits back for part of the damage.

0e3ctes.text: Untouchable. The whorl takes no damage.

0vdfbnr.raw: 'Unstoppable. Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, Taunt, and Slow do not work on it.'
0vdfbnr.text: Unstoppable. Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, Taunt, and Slow do not work on it.

0ycs6jg.raw: 'Stasis. The whorl skips its turns. Nothing can hurt it or give it a status.'
0ycs6jg.text: Stasis. The whorl skips its turns. Nothing can hurt it or give it a status.

1kie1tb.raw: 'Hidden. A foe\'s single hits cannot find it. Its own next hit goes through Guard.'
1kie1tb.text: Hidden. A foe's single hits cannot find it. Its own next hit goes through Guard.

0izd5wz.raw: 'Monument. The whorl cannot be knocked out. It stays at 1 HP.'
0izd5wz.text: Monument. The whorl cannot be knocked out. It stays at 1 HP.

0sidt16.raw: 'When a whorl switches out, it drops most statuses. Burn, Bleed, Poison, Rot, Doom, Ward, Regen, and Hidden stay on it.'
0sidt16.text: When a whorl switches out, it drops most statuses. Burn, Bleed, Poison, Rot, Doom, Ward, Regen, and Hidden stay on it.

132jebo.raw: 'A mark is a sign that some moves put on a whorl. Each kind has its own marks. Kivishi gets a Stone each time it is hit.'
132jebo.text: A mark is a sign that some moves put on a whorl. Each kind has its own marks. Kivishi gets a Stone each time it is hit.

1j5n0sz.raw: 'A mark shows as a small diamond by the HP bar. The number by it is how many stacks it has.'
1j5n0sz.text: A mark shows as a small diamond by the HP bar. The number by it is how many stacks it has.

0rowrfc.raw: 'To learn what a mark does, read the habits of the whorl that makes it. In a battle, press left or right on the menu.'
0rowrfc.text: To learn what a mark does, read the habits of the whorl that makes it. In a battle, press left or right on the menu.

129i7qr.raw: 'Some marks fade after a few turns. Some go away when the whorl switches out.'
129i7qr.text: Some marks fade after a few turns. Some go away when the whorl switches out.

0q2jac1.raw: 'Some moves call a helper onto the field. This helper is a summon. It stands by its whorl. It has a small HP bar under it.'
0q2jac1.text: Some moves call a helper onto the field. This helper is a summon. It stands by its whorl. It has a small HP bar under it.

0okk8ob.raw: `Each side can have ${SUMMON_CAP} summons. A new one past that pushes out the oldest.`
0okk8ob.text: Each side can have {SUMMON_CAP} summons. A new one past that pushes out the oldest.

1sfqzag.raw: 'A summon acts by itself. Some summons hit foes. Some guard their whorl. A summon that guards takes single hits meant for its out whorl.'
1sfqzag.text: A summon acts by itself. Some summons hit foes. Some guard their whorl. A summon that guards takes single hits meant for its out whorl.

1k382ll.raw: 'A summon has no DEF or RES. Each hit on it does half its power.'
1k382ll.text: A summon has no DEF or RES. Each hit on it does half its power.

1pt1m2z.raw: 'You can aim at some summons. When you pick Attack, you may pick the summon instead of the whorl.'
1pt1m2z.text: You can aim at some summons. When you pick Attack, you may pick the summon instead of the whorl.

0n3e3cd.raw: 'A summon leaves when its HP runs out. Some leave after a set number of turns.'
0n3e3cd.text: A summon leaves when its HP runs out. Some leave after a set number of turns.

0dd8kp4.raw: 'A shield is extra HP on top of the HP bar. A hit takes the shield first. It shows as a pale line over the HP bar. A shield fades after a few turns.'
0dd8kp4.text: A shield is extra HP on top of the HP bar. A hit takes the shield first. It shows as a pale line over the HP bar. A shield fades after a few turns.

0ft0oe5.raw: 'You can catch a wild whorl with a horn. The game calls this sounding. A sounded whorl joins your team.'
0ft0oe5.text: You can catch a wild whorl with a horn. The game calls this sounding. A sounded whorl joins your team.

03rizkz.raw: 'In a battle with a wild whorl, pick Sound. Then pick a horn. You can only sound wild whorls.'
03rizkz.text: In a battle with a wild whorl, pick Sound. Then pick a horn. You can only sound wild whorls.

1skw88u.raw: 'Each horn puts a line on the foe\'s HP bar. If the foe\'s HP is at the line or under it, the horn always works.'
1skw88u.text: Each horn puts a line on the foe's HP bar. If the foe's HP is at the line or under it, the horn always works.

0ebnqv5.raw: `Periwinkle horn. The line is at ${pct(HORN_LINE.twig)}%. It costs ${HORN_PRICE.twig} cowries.`
0ebnqv5.text: Periwinkle horn. The line is at {#1}%. It costs {HORN_PRICE.twig} cowries.

01pi4ew.raw: `Whelk horn. The line is at ${pct(HORN_LINE.brass)}%. It costs ${HORN_PRICE.brass} cowries.`
01pi4ew.text: Whelk horn. The line is at {#1}%. It costs {HORN_PRICE.brass} cowries.

1muhdpr.raw: `Triton horn. The line is at ${pct(HORN_LINE.bone)}%. It costs ${HORN_PRICE.bone} cowries.`
1muhdpr.text: Triton horn. The line is at {#1}%. It costs {HORN_PRICE.bone} cowries.

0uoepzj.raw: 'Nautilus horn. It always works. You can find these, but no shop sells them.'
0uoepzj.text: Nautilus horn. It always works. You can find these, but no shop sells them.

1uq9ayt.raw: `Over the line, a horn may still work. The lower the foe's HP, the better the chance. A Periwinkle horn always has at least a ${pct(HORN_FLOOR.twig)}% chance.`
1uq9ayt.text: Over the line, a horn may still work. The lower the foe's HP, the better the chance. A Periwinkle horn always has at least a {#1}% chance.

0ybg1uo.raw: 'So first make the foe weak. But do not knock it out. A wild whorl that is knocked out gets away.'
0ybg1uo.text: So first make the foe weak. But do not knock it out. A wild whorl that is knocked out gets away.

043htsp.raw: `Some things help. If the foe is stunned or asleep, the line goes up ${pct(HORN_HELD)}%. If your whorl has more CHA than the foe, the line goes up too, by up to ${pct(HORN_CHA_MAX)}%. Less CHA moves it down.`
043htsp.text: Some things help. If the foe is stunned or asleep, the line goes up {#1}%. If your whorl has more CHA than the foe, the line goes up too, by up to {#2}%. Less CHA moves it down.

0vlnnzl.raw: 'If the horn does not work, you still lose your turn.'
0vlnnzl.text: If the horn does not work, you still lose your turn.

1kf9xgz.raw: 'If your team is full, the new whorl goes to the Midden.'
1kf9xgz.text: If your team is full, the new whorl goes to the Midden.

1l9z8mo.raw: 'In a battle with a wild whorl, you can also pick Run. Run always works.'
1l9z8mo.text: In a battle with a wild whorl, you can also pick Run. Run always works.

13zz9py.raw: 'A notion is a small thing that a whorl holds. Each whorl can hold one notion.'
13zz9py.text: A notion is a small thing that a whorl holds. Each whorl can hold one notion.

07qy65w.raw: 'Some notions raise a stat. A Whetstone adds 5% ATK. Other notions change how a whorl fights. Bloodglass heals the whorl a little each time it deals damage.'
07qy65w.text: Some notions raise a stat. A Whetstone adds 5% ATK. Other notions change how a whorl fights. Bloodglass heals the whorl a little each time it deals damage.

1ciohiy.raw: 'To give a notion, press X for the menu. Pick Team, then a whorl, then Give notion. Take notion puts it back in the Bag.'
1ciohiy.text: To give a notion, press X for the menu. Pick Team, then a whorl, then Give notion. Take notion puts it back in the Bag.

0oow8cr.raw: 'Some notions have an action. The action is a choice in the battle menu. It works once each battle. It is quick, like a Switch.'
0oow8cr.text: Some notions have an action. The action is a choice in the battle menu. It works once each battle. It is quick, like a Switch.

102f905.raw: 'Some notions get used up. A Sea Biscuit heals 20% of the whorl\'s HP. After that battle, the Sea Biscuit is gone.'
102f905.text: Some notions get used up. A Sea Biscuit heals 20% of the whorl's HP. After that battle, the Sea Biscuit is gone.

10j0k20.raw: 'You can buy notions at a grotto. Read each one in the Bag before you give it.'
10j0k20.text: You can buy notions at a grotto. Read each one in the Bag before you give it.

00o139z.raw: 'Nacre is the shiny lining of a shell. You find it in hidden spots. One piece of nacre is one layer.'
00o139z.text: Nacre is the shiny lining of a shell. You find it in hidden spots. One piece of nacre is one layer.

1g7astb.raw: `At a grotto, pick Nacre. Then layer nacre on a whorl. Each layer adds ${pct(TAN_STEP)}% to one stat.`
1g7astb.text: At a grotto, pick Nacre. Then layer nacre on a whorl. Each layer adds {#1}% to one stat.

1sfz8hc.raw: `A whorl can take ${TAN_PER_STAT} layers in one stat. It can take ${TAN_TOTAL} layers in all.`
1sfz8hc.text: A whorl can take {TAN_PER_STAT} layers in one stat. It can take {TAN_TOTAL} layers in all.

1k57mqe.raw: `Here is an example. Say a whorl has 69 ATK. With ${TAN_PER_STAT} layers on ATK, it has ${Math.round(69 * (1 + TAN_STEP * TAN_PER_STAT))} ATK.`
1k57mqe.text: Here is an example. Say a whorl has 69 ATK. With {TAN_PER_STAT} layers on ATK, it has {#2} ATK.

0fvxzpz.raw: 'You can take the layers off for free. Pick Take all layers off. Then you get every layer back to use again.'
0fvxzpz.text: You can take the layers off for free. Pick Take all layers off. Then you get every layer back to use again.

1d7pkiv.raw: 'To conjoin is to join two whorls into one new whorl. The Conjoiner does it at a grotto.'
1d7pkiv.text: To conjoin is to join two whorls into one new whorl. The Conjoiner does it at a grotto.

11pvvv4.raw: 'You pick what the new whorl keeps. It keeps 2 moves from each whorl. It keeps 2 of their habits. It takes 1 or 2 of their types. You also pick its look and its name.'
11pvvv4.text: You pick what the new whorl keeps. It keeps 2 moves from each whorl. It keeps 2 of their habits. It takes 1 or 2 of their types. You also pick its look and its name.

1d2bbk7.text: It can keep 2 crests at most.

1kvhqn3.raw: 'You may retune one move. A retuned move takes one of the new whorl\'s types.'
1kvhqn3.text: You may retune one move. A retuned move takes one of the new whorl's types.

0o6qz95.raw: 'The new whorl gets the higher level of the two.'
0o6qz95.text: The new whorl gets the higher level of the two.

13m82me.raw: 'It costs 10 cowries for each level of the higher whorl. Two level 20 whorls cost 200 cowries.'
13m82me.text: It costs 10 cowries for each level of the higher whorl. Two level 20 whorls cost 200 cowries.

070z2kk.raw: 'Conjoining cannot be undone. Both old whorls are gone after it. Their notions go back to your Bag.'
070z2kk.text: Conjoining cannot be undone. Both old whorls are gone after it. Their notions go back to your Bag.

1rculhu.raw: `The seam is where the two whorls join. The seam costs the new whorl ${pct(1 - FIT_STAT)}% of every stat.`
1rculhu.text: The seam is where the two whorls join. The seam costs the new whorl {#1}% of every stat.

0hs96pq.raw: 'A conjoined whorl cannot be conjoined again. Some whorls cannot be conjoined at all. The menu shows them in gray.'
0hs96pq.text: A conjoined whorl cannot be conjoined again. Some whorls cannot be conjoined at all. The menu shows them in gray.

1v70gwf.raw: 'A whorl grows by winning battles. Each win gives experience, called XP. Enough XP gives the whorl a new level. A new level raises its stats.'
1v70gwf.text: A whorl grows by winning battles. Each win gives experience, called XP. Enough XP gives the whorl a new level. A new level raises its stats.

18tdkzp.raw: 'Every whorl in your team gets the XP. It does not matter if it fought. Whorls in the Midden get half.'
18tdkzp.text: Every whorl in your team gets the XP. It does not matter if it fought. Whorls in the Midden get half.

1k4w8bg.raw: 'When you win, each foe you knocked out or sounded gives XP. A level 10 wild whorl gives 24 XP. A level 10 whorl of a trainer gives 32 XP.'
1k4w8bg.text: When you win, each foe you knocked out or sounded gives XP. A level 10 wild whorl gives 24 XP. A level 10 whorl of a trainer gives 32 XP.

1x4d4iu.raw: 'Each level needs more XP than the last. A level 5 whorl needs 72 XP to reach level 6.'
1x4d4iu.text: Each level needs more XP than the last. A level 5 whorl needs 72 XP to reach level 6.

1vt0u0h.raw: 'A whorl cannot grow past the level cap. Each pearl you win raises the cap. You win a pearl when you beat a keeper.'
1vt0u0h.text: A whorl cannot grow past the level cap. Each pearl you win raises the cap. You win a pearl when you beat a keeper.

1r3zn01.raw: 'When your team reaches the cap, the battle tells you.'
1r3zn01.text: When your team reaches the cap, the battle tells you.

1l9491d.raw: 'Very long battles make whorls tired. This is called fatigue.'
1l9491d.text: Very long battles make whorls tired. This is called fatigue.

19pp9pa.raw: `A round is one turn for each side. Fatigue starts after round ${FATIGUE_ROUND}.`
19pp9pa.text: A round is one turn for each side. Fatigue starts after round {FATIGUE_ROUND}.

1rkp45f.raw: `In round ${FATIGUE_ROUND + 1}, each out whorl loses 5% of its max HP. In round ${FATIGUE_ROUND + 2}, it loses 10%. It goes up by 5% each round.`
1rkp45f.text: In round {#1}, each out whorl loses 5% of its max HP. In round {#2}, it loses 10%. It goes up by 5% each round.

0rgndt8.raw: 'Fatigue goes past DEF, RES, and Guard. The slower whorl gets hit first.'
0rgndt8.text: Fatigue goes past DEF, RES, and Guard. The slower whorl gets hit first.

1kc7lj7.raw: 'So no battle can go on forever. Try to win before fatigue starts.'
1kc7lj7.text: So no battle can go on forever. Try to win before fatigue starts.

07xj97q.raw: 'You can wear your lead whorl. Press C to put it on. Press C again to take it off.'
07xj97q.text: You can wear your lead whorl. Press C to put it on. Press C again to take it off.

1oh0hje.raw: 'When you wear a whorl, its type lets you cross new ground.'
1oh0hje.text: When you wear a whorl, its type lets you cross new ground.

1bknixs.raw: 'STONE lets you walk over crazes. A craze is a crack in the ground.'
1bknixs.text: STONE lets you walk over crazes. A craze is a crack in the ground.

1gm13u8.raw: 'TIDE lets you walk on water and through shallows.'
1gm13u8.text: TIDE lets you walk on water and through shallows.

1csb1lc.text: ROOT lets you go through thickets.

161jq9r.raw: 'GEAR lets you pass dead machines. It also turns old cranes.'
161jq9r.text: GEAR lets you pass dead machines. It also turns old cranes.

1y5ytnr.raw: 'A whorl with two types lets you do both things.'
1y5ytnr.text: A whorl with two types lets you do both things.

0l2xaj8.raw: 'The Bag holds what you carry. Press X for the menu and pick Bag.'
0l2xaj8.text: The Bag holds what you carry. Press X for the menu and pick Bag.

11zzux2.raw: 'The Bag has six pockets. Press left or right to change the pocket.'
11zzux2.text: The Bag has six pockets. Press left or right to change the pocket.

11j8z5x.raw: 'Items has horns and things to use, like a Salt Line.'
11j8z5x.text: Items has horns and things to use, like a Salt Line.

06v4d56.raw: 'Notions has notions for your whorls to hold.'
06v4d56.text: Notions has notions for your whorls to hold.

0sx8ci2.raw: 'Key items has things for the story. You cannot sell or toss them.'
0sx8ci2.text: Key items has things for the story. You cannot sell or toss them.

0d6g9ly.raw: 'Finds has things to sell at a grotto.'
0d6g9ly.text: Finds has things to sell at a grotto.

1jbf9il.text: Lore has things you can read.

17ql8wm.raw: 'Sketches has drawings for the Setting board.'
17ql8wm.text: Sketches has drawings for the Setting board.

1ghw4op.raw: 'Pick a thing and press Z. Then you can use, read, give, take, or toss it. It depends on the thing.'
1ghw4op.text: Pick a thing and press Z. Then you can use, read, give, take, or toss it. It depends on the thing.

1sjneaw.raw: 'Press V to sort a pocket by name, or by kind.'
1sjneaw.text: Press V to sort a pocket by name, or by kind.

13e37g2.raw: 'A Salt Line keeps wild whorls away for 150 steps. A Lure Shell brings out the rarest kind on that map. A Carter\'s Whistle calls the cart one time.'
13e37g2.text: A Salt Line keeps wild whorls away for 150 steps. A Lure Shell brings out the rarest kind on that map. A Carter's Whistle calls the cart one time.

0blukoh.raw: 'Key items open new places or help the story. The Register is a key item. It lists each kind you have seen and each kind you have sounded.'
0blukoh.text: Key items open new places or help the story. The Register is a key item. It lists each kind you have seen and each kind you have sounded.

0nkxplb.raw: 'Cowries are shells that you spend like money.'
0nkxplb.text: Cowries are shells that you spend like money.

1ouf7y9.raw: 'You get cowries when you beat a trainer. Each whorl of the trainer pays 12 cowries for each of its levels. Two level 10 whorls pay 240 cowries.'
1ouf7y9.text: You get cowries when you beat a trainer. Each whorl of the trainer pays 12 cowries for each of its levels. Two level 10 whorls pay 240 cowries.

1b6e3os.raw: 'You can sell finds at a grotto. Pick Sell there. The Bag shows what each find sells for. The Strandmonger pays 25% more.'
1b6e3os.text: You can sell finds at a grotto. Pick Sell there. The Bag shows what each find sells for. The Strandmonger pays 25% more.

0gndhil.raw: 'You spend cowries on horns, notions, and things to use. Conjoining costs cowries. A ride on the cart costs 10.'
0gndhil.text: You spend cowries on horns, notions, and things to use. Conjoining costs cowries. A ride on the cart costs 10.

1ynct5y.raw: 'If your whole team is down, you drop 20% of your cowries. If you have 500, you drop 100.'
1ynct5y.text: If your whole team is down, you drop 20% of your cowries. If you have 500, you drop 100.

1o3b64k.raw: 'You can wear a pearl as a charm. A charm helps your whole team in battle. You can wear one charm at a time.'
1o3b64k.text: You can wear a pearl as a charm. A charm helps your whole team in battle. You can wear one charm at a time.

0o1yp3y.raw: 'Press X for the menu and pick Charm.'
0o1yp3y.text: Press X for the menu and pick Charm.

0cdy6zz.raw: 'Rib. Your lead takes 15% less damage until it switches out.'
0cdy6zz.text: Rib. Your lead takes 15% less damage until it switches out.

1pc6om4.text: Mast. Your tide starts at 4, not 2.

0jxg6x5.raw: 'Bole. Your conjoined whorls deal 8% more damage.'
0jxg6x5.text: Bole. Your conjoined whorls deal 8% more damage.

1tjav7z.raw: 'Pylon. A notion action works twice each battle. A notion that gets used up still works once.'
1tjav7z.text: Pylon. A notion action works twice each battle. A notion that gets used up still works once.

0gehujg.raw: 'Tusk. Your whorl waits 20% less after a Switch.'
0gehujg.text: Tusk. Your whorl waits 20% less after a Switch.

1ly3za6.raw: 'Hilt. When your whorl knocks out a foe, its cooldowns drop by 1.'
1ly3za6.text: Hilt. When your whorl knocks out a foe, its cooldowns drop by 1.

1n302ep.text: Fall. Your first turn comes 25% sooner.

0rm4a8w.raw: 'A Starborn whorl is a rare whorl with the colors of the night sky. It glows, and it twinkles.'
0rm4a8w.text: A Starborn whorl is a rare whorl with the colors of the night sky. It glows, and it twinkles.

0y48i6o.raw: `About 1 in ${STARBORN_ODDS} new wild whorls is Starborn. A new conjoined whorl can be Starborn too, at the same odds.`
0y48i6o.text: About 1 in {STARBORN_ODDS} new wild whorls is Starborn. A new conjoined whorl can be Starborn too, at the same odds.

1kpv1bm.raw: 'A Starborn whorl is just as strong as others of its kind. Only its look is different.'
1kpv1bm.text: A Starborn whorl is just as strong as others of its kind. Only its look is different.

0ge635m.raw: 'A Starborn whorl does not pass on its look when you conjoin it.'
0ge635m.text: A Starborn whorl does not pass on its look when you conjoin it.

1smc8tv.raw: 'Once you see a Starborn whorl, the Register marks its kind with a star.'
1smc8tv.text: Once you see a Starborn whorl, the Register marks its kind with a star.

18yyzep.raw: 'Setting is a puzzle board for setting gems. Press X for the menu and pick Setting.'
18yyzep.text: Setting is a puzzle board for setting gems. Press X for the menu and pick Setting.

09cql93.raw: 'Each sketch you find is a new puzzle. You build a machine that makes the piece in the sketch.'
09cql93.text: Each sketch you find is a new puzzle. You build a machine that makes the piece in the sketch.

1lahd15.raw: 'You put arms and stations on the board. Each arm follows its tape. A tape is a list of steps. Every arm takes one step at the same time.'
1lahd15.text: You put arms and stations on the board. Each arm follows its tape. A tape is a list of steps. Every arm takes one step at the same time.

0bhujsw.raw: 'Grab picks up the stone at the claw. Turning swings the arm. A polisher shines a stone. A setter joins two stones. A splitter breaks them apart.'
0bhujsw.text: Grab picks up the stone at the claw. Turning swings the arm. A polisher shines a stone. A setter joins two stones. A splitter breaks them apart.

092jcmf.raw: 'Pick Run to watch the machine go. Pick Step to go one step at a time. Pick Help to read the rules again.'
092jcmf.text: Pick Run to watch the machine go. Pick Step to go one step at a time. Pick Help to read the rules again.

11pewwr.raw: 'A puzzle you solve keeps your best score. Try to use fewer cycles, less cost, or less room.'
11pewwr.text: A puzzle you solve keeps your best score. Try to use fewer cycles, less cost, or less room.

1ystc9x.raw: 'Practice is on the title screen. It is a place to try out teams. Nothing you do there is saved.'
1ystc9x.text: Practice is on the title screen. It is a place to try out teams. Nothing you do there is saved.

1krofjx.raw: 'You make two teams of 3. Your team is on the left. The foe\'s team is on the right.'
1krofjx.text: You make two teams of 3. Your team is on the left. The foe's team is on the right.

0f7b98r.raw: 'Pick a slot to change it. You can get a random whorl, find any kind by its name, or conjoin two kinds.'
0f7b98r.text: Pick a slot to change it. You can get a random whorl, find any kind by its name, or conjoin two kinds.

0w0d49x.raw: 'Practice battles have tide. Every whorl is level 25 unless you change it.'
0w0d49x.text: Practice battles have tide. Every whorl is level 25 unless you change it.

0njyvt6.raw: 'In a practice battle, press V to open the debug menu. It shows the stats of every whorl. It also shows the foe\'s last choice. You can change HP and tide there too.'
0njyvt6.text: In a practice battle, press V to open the debug menu. It shows the stats of every whorl. It also shows the foe's last choice. You can change HP and tide there too.

124uhp1.raw: 'When the battle ends, you go back to the teams. Press Start again to play the same battle.'
124uhp1.text: When the battle ends, you go back to the teams. Press Start again to play the same battle.

0g79kf6.raw: 'On the Strand, your whorls fight at their Strand level. It starts at 3. It only goes up on the Strand.'
0g79kf6.text: On the Strand, your whorls fight at their Strand level. It starts at 3. It only goes up on the Strand.

11ov2uq.raw: 'Star grains raise the cap on Strand levels.'
11ov2uq.text: Star grains raise the cap on Strand levels.

19dtqmp.raw: 'The sea comes in and goes out. Ring a tide bell to turn the tide.'
19dtqmp.text: The sea comes in and goes out. Ring a tide bell to turn the tide.

0yke9x6.raw: 'At high tide, each side starts a battle with 3 tide. At low tide, each side starts with none. Then a star lands every 4th round. It adds 2 tide to each side.'
0yke9x6.text: At high tide, each side starts a battle with 3 tide. At low tide, each side starts with none. Then a star lands every 4th round. It adds 2 tide to each side.

1y47pj4.raw: 'Two more types live on the Strand. They are SALT and VOID.'
1y47pj4.text: Two more types live on the Strand. They are SALT and VOID.

1tug7n1.raw: 'SALT is strong against ROOT and BEAST. TIDE is strong against SALT.'
1tug7n1.text: SALT is strong against ROOT and BEAST. TIDE is strong against SALT.

1c6v73p.raw: 'VOID is strong against STAR and SALT. STONE and GEAR are strong against VOID.'
1c6v73p.text: VOID is strong against STAR and SALT. STONE and GEAR are strong against VOID.

0djos5f.raw: 'Wear a SALT whorl to walk through gray. Wear a VOID whorl to cross the blank.'
0djos5f.text: Wear a SALT whorl to walk through gray. Wear a VOID whorl to cross the blank.

1qf42km.raw: 'You can leave a whorl in a shell on the Strand. A shell with a whorl in it stays.'
1qf42km.text: You can leave a whorl in a shell on the Strand. A shell with a whorl in it stays.

0nmbfrb.raw: 'Weaving a coat for my cast. It stands in that corner all winter.'
0nmbfrb.text: Weaving a coat for my cast. It stands in that corner all winter.

133sm2o.text: Cold, I bet. It never says.

02ubpn1.raw: 'Bread\'s Midden Road wheat. Crust\'s got a bit of shell in it.'
02ubpn1.text: Bread's Midden Road wheat. Crust's got a bit of shell in it.

1q0hq8l.raw: 'In the chest, under a cloth, two sea biscuits somebody saved.'
1q0hq8l.text: In the chest, under a cloth, two sea biscuits somebody saved.

1q35xcs.raw: 'Baby turned last week. Cast\'s smaller than a teacup.'
1q35xcs.text: Baby turned last week. Cast's smaller than a teacup.

1hjdm73.raw: 'We keep it in the cradle. Baby sleeps on the floor. Babies, huh.'
1hjdm73.text: We keep it in the cradle. Baby sleeps on the floor. Babies, huh.

0i7wxth.raw: 'The Rib hums at night. You get used to it.'
0i7wxth.text: The Rib hums at night. You get used to it.

1bzqjki.raw: 'Well. I didn\'t. I just got old.'
1bzqjki.text: Well. I didn't. I just got old.

0qrjyrf.raw: 'Eight little bone Stays on the shelf, each with a name scratched under it.'
0qrjyrf.text: Eight little bone Stays on the shelf, each with a name scratched under it.

0xjef70.raw: 'We\'re turning on the same day. We decided.'
0xjef70.text: We're turning on the same day. We decided.

15gwg61.text: She decided. I just said okay.

1t72mun.raw: 'Sit by the fire if you like. It\'s for my cast, mostly.'
1t72mun.text: Sit by the fire if you like. It's for my cast, mostly.

0o93oni.raw: 'Gets stiff in the cold. Like me. Like me exactly.'
0o93oni.text: Gets stiff in the cold. Like me. Like me exactly.

0wj80rm.raw: 'Mending nets for a sea that isn\'t there.'
0wj80rm.text: Mending nets for a sea that isn't there.

0tjvniv.text: Good practice. For when it is.

1xooqyi.raw: 'Every shell here came off the Dry Sea floor.'
1xooqyi.text: Every shell here came off the Dry Sea floor.

0ojm1e6.raw: 'I sort them by how sad they look. That row\'s the saddest.'
0ojm1e6.text: I sort them by how sad they look. That row's the saddest.

1q49f61.raw: 'Three beds and no ship. We take turns being the watch.'
1q49f61.text: Three beds and no ship. We take turns being the watch.

0nrx37y.raw: 'Nothing\'s happened yet. Very well watched, though.'
0nrx37y.text: Nothing's happened yet. Very well watched, though.

1s1n2f8.raw: 'A pot of something with seaweed in it, bubbling. It smells better than it looks.'
1s1n2f8.text: A pot of something with seaweed in it, bubbling. It smells better than it looks.

0fqultp.raw: 'In the chest, a jar of sea glass sorted by color.'
0fqultp.text: In the chest, a jar of sea glass sorted by color.

1k9946v.raw: 'Spire\'s quiet hours are most of the hours.'
1k9946v.text: Spire's quiet hours are most of the hours.

1f987jy.raw: 'I tune Spire\'s bells by ear. My ears are bad.'
1f987jy.text: I tune Spire's bells by ear. My ears are bad.

0m6v0nh.raw: 'They\'re all a bit wrong now. Nobody\'s said anything.'
0m6v0nh.text: They're all a bit wrong now. Nobody's said anything.

04t2j9b.raw: 'Bell clappers wrapped in cloth, so they can\'t ring by accident.'
04t2j9b.text: Bell clappers wrapped in cloth, so they can't ring by accident.

0enj6qh.raw: 'Roots come up through the floor every spring.'
0enj6qh.text: Roots come up through the floor every spring.

1t4idao.raw: 'We just move the table. Table\'s been all over.'
1t4idao.text: We just move the table. Table's been all over.

08dgrye.raw: 'Buckets catch the rain that falls up. Then I put a lid on.'
08dgrye.text: Buckets catch the rain that falls up. Then I put a lid on.

0u63xg8.raw: 'Then I lose the lid. Then the rain goes.'
0u63xg8.text: Then I lose the lid. Then the rain goes.

1fquhqw.raw: 'I carve spoons out of the bark the Bole drops.'
1fquhqw.text: I carve spoons out of the bark the Bole drops.

0x1gdhd.raw: 'They taste a bit like tree. People are fine with it.'
0x1gdhd.text: They taste a bit like tree. People are fine with it.

1dvhr36.raw: 'A note on the pillow: "Gone to watch the Bole. Back by dark. Don\'t eat the jam."'
1dvhr36.text: A note on the pillow: "Gone to watch the Bole. Back by dark. Don't eat the jam."

1tfr7mc.raw: 'I\'m raising a whorl in a crate. It\'s a snail right now.'
1tfr7mc.text: I'm raising a whorl in a crate. It's a snail right now.

1961nim.raw: 'Snails grow shells. Then it\'s a whorl. I\'m very patient.'
1961nim.text: Snails grow shells. Then it's a whorl. I'm very patient.

1n742am.text: Rider parts. Every one still ticks.

07zrljw.raw: 'I count the ticks, so they know someone\'s listening.'
07zrljw.text: I count the ticks, so they know someone's listening.

1k0y79f.raw: 'The Pylon shines through the wall at night. Blue, then less blue.'
1k0y79f.text: The Pylon shines through the wall at night. Blue, then less blue.

1nr0e86.raw: 'A Rider\'s helmet, upside down, used as a fruit bowl. The fruit is also a bit metal.'
1nr0e86.text: A Rider's helmet, upside down, used as a fruit bowl. The fruit is also a bit metal.

1cvd7mz.raw: 'In the chest, a Rider tin with the seal still on.'
1cvd7mz.text: In the chest, a Rider tin with the seal still on.

19t6g85.raw: 'Tusk winters, you keep the fire in and the cast out.'
19t6g85.text: Tusk winters, you keep the fire in and the cast out.

0npjp0i.raw: 'Casts don\'t mind cold. They mind fires.'
0npjp0i.text: Casts don't mind cold. They mind fires.

0nzqm22.raw: 'I carve the Tusk\'s chips into combs.'
0nzqm22.text: I carve the Tusk's chips into combs.

0rtr44f.raw: 'The Tusk doesn\'t mind. Or it\'s being polite.'
0rtr44f.text: The Tusk doesn't mind. Or it's being polite.

1q5y04b.raw: 'Off duty. Still guarding the sword in my sleep.'
1q5y04b.text: Off duty. Still guarding the sword in my sleep.

0efj6ou.raw: 'Sword\'s very still. So am I. We\'re good at it.'
0efj6ou.text: Sword's very still. So am I. We're good at it.

055a4lm.text: My husband guarded that sword forty years. Never saw the blade.

1qap0ps.raw: 'He saw it this week. Says it\'s fine. Bit plain.'
1qap0ps.text: He saw it this week. Says it's fine. Bit plain.

007o6qs.raw: 'I polish the guards\' buttons. Lot of guards.'
007o6qs.text: I polish the guards' buttons. Lot of guards.

1x2cukg.text: Lot of buttons. I've never been bored. I've been close.

1h824ih.text: Everything in here rolls east. The chairs too.

0x8vez7.text: I just sit wherever the chair stopped.

078uyr3.text: I count the stars that land. Two thousand and six this year.

0qwknkd.raw: 'I might\'ve counted some twice. Stars look alike.'
0qwknkd.text: I might've counted some twice. Stars look alike.

0awfsuv.text: The brook talks all night. I talk back.

0eeh95w.text: One of us is learning something. Not sure who.

0v988nk.text: Then the lesson cost nothing and you got all of it.

0t3k0vg.text: Knock it down a bit, then sound it. Weaker means surer. Then it's yours, and I stop feeding a boot.

0aglz4t.text: (Your whorl fights the boot. You pick one action each turn.)

13pud40.text: (Attack never runs out. A move hits harder. Then it rests a few turns before you can use it again.)

13nb49k.text: (Look at a choice before you pick it. It says what it does, and if the foe is weak to it.)

0pxv9cx.raw: '(Guard cuts the damage you take in half until your next turn.)'
0pxv9cx.text: (Guard cuts the damage you take in half until your next turn.)

18eg53h.text: (Switch sends out a whorl from your reserve. You only have one whorl for now.)

0lu8esj.raw: '(A horn can sound a whorl at any HP. The lower its HP, the better the chance.)'
0lu8esj.text: (A horn can sound a whorl at any HP. The lower its HP, the better the chance.)

03zuv1o.text: (The boot is under the line on its HP bar now. Under the line, the horn never fails.)
