189ghkn.raw: 'A giant\'s back tooth, hollow as a whelk. Looks out of its roots. Grows on what it chews. Four cowries, no biting.'
189ghkn.text: A giant's back tooth, hollow as a whelk. Looks out of its roots. Grows on what it chews. Four cowries, no biting.

10iai4o.raw: 'Which is the top bone of a giant\'s neck. Held a head up three hundred years. Now it holds a grudge. Holds out for four cowries, too.'
10iai4o.text: Which is the top bone of a giant's neck. Held a head up three hundred years. Now it holds a grudge. Holds out for four cowries, too.

1u2891i.raw: 'Off a giant\'s nail. It scratches the same spot until the spot gives. Three cowries, unfiled.'
1u2891i.text: Off a giant's nail. It scratches the same spot until the spot gives. Three cowries, unfiled.

0aq6f96.raw: 'The ball and cup of a giant\'s hip. The head never sits level, leans hard one way or the other. Three cowries. Mine leans left.'
0aq6f96.text: The ball and cup of a giant's hip. The head never sits level, leans hard one way or the other. Three cowries. Mine leans left.

1v35szt.raw: 'A wishbone off a bird bigger than a barn. Pulls long, then short, then long again. Five cowries. I wished for six.'
1v35szt.text: A wishbone off a bird bigger than a barn. Pulls long, then short, then long again. Five cowries. I wished for six.

04knk2e.raw: 'Off the dry sea floor, an urchin\'s test, mouth underneath. Whatever sticks to it falls off. Two cowries, unsticky.'
04knk2e.text: Off the dry sea floor, an urchin's test, mouth underneath. Whatever sticks to it falls off. Two cowries, unsticky.

1g1qeap.raw: 'A fiddler crab, one claw bigger than the rest. Hit the claw and the claw hits back. Three cowries, claw extra.'
1g1qeap.text: A fiddler crab, one claw bigger than the rest. Hit the claw and the claw hits back. Three cowries, claw extra.

1yzuzov.raw: 'Plus the water that hangs over the dry sea, standing on its own reflection. Stones go through it. Four cowries, see-through.'
1yzuzov.text: Plus the water that hangs over the dry sea, standing on its own reflection. Stones go through it. Four cowries, see-through.

03rqsti.raw: 'Off the Wrecks, an anchor walking on its flukes. Marks a spot and puts you back on it. You\'ll be back. Bring five cowries.'
03rqsti.text: Off the Wrecks, an anchor walking on its flukes. Marks a spot and puts you back on it. You'll be back. Bring five cowries.

1od3ccn.raw: 'And a figurehead that left before the ship went down. Still stands in front of people. Pass the five cowries round it.'
1od3ccn.text: And a figurehead that left before the ship went down. Still stands in front of people. Pass the five cowries round it.

1tbdk2r.raw: 'A bilge pump with no ship left to bail. Pumps your tide out instead. Three cowries. The bilge boy wants it back.'
1tbdk2r.text: A bilge pump with no ship left to bail. Pumps your tide out instead. Three cowries. The bilge boy wants it back.

10boyvl.raw: 'A torn sail, mast through its face. Tacks with every wind, and there\'s no wind. Two cowries. I\'ve tried blowing.'
10boyvl.text: A torn sail, mast through its face. Tacks with every wind, and there's no wind. Two cowries. I've tried blowing.

10wd582.raw: 'Which nothing\'s moved in forty years, a keel off the dry sea. It moves others a long way. Five cowries, no delivery.'
10wd582.text: Which nothing's moved in forty years, a keel off the dry sea. It moves others a long way. Five cowries, no delivery.

1c54e3l.raw: 'A ship\'s cannon that talks through the top of its head. The shot lands where you are by then. Four cowries, plus ducking.'
1c54e3l.text: A ship's cannon that talks through the top of its head. The shot lands where you are by then. Four cowries, plus ducking.

0kqj163.raw: 'Off the gray wall, a breaking wave, one eye in the curl. Drags at you till someone hits it. Four cowries, wet.'
0kqj163.text: Off the gray wall, a breaking wave, one eye in the curl. Drags at you till someone hits it. Four cowries, wet.

1beroqt.raw: 'And a skua, second beak in its belly. Follows one of yours and gets paid when it drops. Three cowries. We\'re in the same trade.'
1beroqt.text: And a skua, second beak in its belly. Follows one of yours and gets paid when it drops. Three cowries. We're in the same trade.

0v0n1c9.raw: 'Off the shoreline, a jellyfish bloom. Stings everything near it and spends your tide doing it. Three cowries. Ow.'
0v0n1c9.text: Off the shoreline, a jellyfish bloom. Stings everything near it and spends your tide doing it. Three cowries. Ow.

1ob4dji.raw: 'Driftwood off the gray wall, face on the cut end. Grows bark on its friends. Two cowries, salted. Unsalted\'s dearer.'
1ob4dji.text: Driftwood off the gray wall, face on the cut end. Grows bark on its friends. Two cowries, salted. Unsalted's dearer.

0rci6l6.raw: 'Sea foam the gray wall let go of. Hit what it\'s holding and the foam keeps the bill. The bill comes. Four cowries, I respect it.'
0rci6l6.text: Sea foam the gray wall let go of. Hit what it's holding and the foam keeps the bill. The bill comes. Four cowries, I respect it.

1gbbz08.raw: 'A scrap of the sea\'s own shell, off the wall at dusk. The sea wants it back. Seven cowries. The sea hasn\'t offered.'
1gbbz08.text: A scrap of the sea's own shell, off the wall at dusk. The sea wants it back. Seven cowries. The sea hasn't offered.

0hxn114.raw: 'A heron on one leg, aiming. The longer it stands there, the worse for you. Three cowries. It\'s aimed at me all week.'
0hxn114.text: A heron on one leg, aiming. The longer it stands there, the worse for you. Three cowries. It's aimed at me all week.

1ap4x69.raw: 'Plus a glass eel. You can see what it ate. Every third bite it doesn\'t let go. Two cowries, and what it ate at cost.'
1ap4x69.text: Plus a glass eel. You can see what it ate. Every third bite it doesn't let go. Two cowries, and what it ate at cost.

0mybaza.raw: 'Off the marsh, a cut of peat looking up out of its top. Keeps what falls in. Three cowries a brick. I\'ve lost a spoon.'
0mybaza.text: Off the marsh, a cut of peat looking up out of its top. Keeps what falls in. Three cowries a brick. I've lost a spoon.

00vnmgq.raw: 'The tenor bell from under Spire, hopping on its clapper. When it rings, what\'s in front stays put. Six cowries. Goes last.'
00vnmgq.text: The tenor bell from under Spire, hopping on its clapper. When it rings, what's in front stays put. Six cowries. Goes last.

1odt086.raw: 'A crazed window from under Spire, an eye in each pane. Each pane takes one hit. Five cowries, by the pane.'
1odt086.text: A crazed window from under Spire, an eye in each pane. Each pane takes one hit. Five cowries, by the pane.

1k8xnpd.raw: 'Which sings out of its middle, an organ pipe. Its notes go on hitting people after it stops. Four cowries, plus earplugs.'
1k8xnpd.text: Which sings out of its middle, an organ pipe. Its notes go on hitting people after it stops. Four cowries, plus earplugs.

088hqon.raw: 'A pew from under Spire, face in the backrest. While it sits, nobody near it goes all the way down. Four cowries, seated.'
088hqon.text: A pew from under Spire, face in the backrest. While it sits, nobody near it goes all the way down. Four cowries, seated.

183jbnt.raw: 'A reliquary, one eye behind the glass. Whatever it puts down, it keeps a piece of. Six cowries. It kept my change.'
183jbnt.text: A reliquary, one eye behind the glass. Whatever it puts down, it keeps a piece of. Six cowries. It kept my change.

0cpnwhh.raw: 'Off its hook in Spire, a censer smoking at the ears. Its smoke closes on you two breaths later. Pay five cowries between breaths.'
0cpnwhh.text: Off its hook in Spire, a censer smoking at the ears. Its smoke closes on you two breaths later. Pay five cowries between breaths.

1v6n9h3.raw: 'And an owl, more eyes painted on its wings. Nothing it looks at can make a sound. I\'d say the price, but it\'s looking. Four cowries.'
1v6n9h3.text: And an owl, more eyes painted on its wings. Nothing it looks at can make a sound. I'd say the price, but it's looking. Four cowries.

04ln66c.raw: 'A stag\'s shell, antlers on. Saves up everything you hit it with. Five cowries. It\'s saving them up too.'
04ln66c.text: A stag's shell, antlers on. Saves up everything you hit it with. Five cowries. It's saving them up too.

1aupc2t.raw: 'A straw beehive the bees left. Stings on its own now, through the door in its belly. Two cowries and gloves. My gloves.'
1aupc2t.text: A straw beehive the bees left. Stings on its own now, through the door in its belly. Two cowries and gloves. My gloves.

04sexw6.raw: 'Off the Bole, a taproot walking on its leaves. Roots things where they stand, and drinks. Three cowries and a drink.'
04sexw6.text: Off the Bole, a taproot walking on its leaves. Roots things where they stand, and drinks. Three cowries and a drink.

1niu2a8.raw: 'A bark beetle, bored right through. Waits in its own holes and hits you on the way out. Two cowries. Holes free.'
1niu2a8.text: A bark beetle, bored right through. Waits in its own holes and hits you on the way out. Two cowries. Holes free.

0z539ry.raw: 'Plus the ball of earth from under the Bole\'s roots. A small lump follows it about. One cowrie. The lump\'s free. The lump insists.'
0z539ry.text: Plus the ball of earth from under the Bole's roots. A small lump follows it about. One cowrie. The lump's free. The lump insists.

1174yzr.raw: 'A sapling off the Rootfall, face in the leaves. Anything that hits its friends gets held. Three cowries. Be its friend.'
1174yzr.text: A sapling off the Rootfall, face in the leaves. Anything that hits its friends gets held. Three cowries. Be its friend.

0s9tm52.raw: 'Which is a face out of the Bole\'s roots, one eye too big. Look at it and you sleep. Whoever wakes you sleeps. Six cowries, if awake.'
0s9tm52.text: Which is a face out of the Bole's roots, one eye too big. Look at it and you sleep. Whoever wakes you sleeps. Six cowries, if awake.

02541e9.raw: 'Rain that fell upward near the Bole and kept at it. Makes friends tall and enemies short. Three cowries. Ask the Upright Man.'
02541e9.text: Rain that fell upward near the Bole and kept at it. Makes friends tall and enemies short. Three cowries. Ask the Upright Man.

14jy60d.raw: 'A brick kiln from the old works. One side still warm. Hand it a notion and it hands it back harder. Four cowries, warm side up.'
14jy60d.text: A brick kiln from the old works. One side still warm. Hand it a notion and it hands it back harder. Four cowries, warm side up.

042kpel.raw: 'Which carries whatever stands on it to the same place, same speed. A conveyor belt\'s shell. Three cowries, same price.'
042kpel.text: Which carries whatever stands on it to the same place, same speed. A conveyor belt's shell. Three cowries, same price.

0aeg932.raw: 'Off the old mast on the Lip, where it kept vigil like a monk. Hums signals in no tongue anyone speaks and passes them round. Four cowries, quiet.'
0aeg932.text: Off the old mast on the Lip, where it kept vigil like a monk. Hums signals in no tongue anyone speaks and passes them round. Four cowries, quiet.

0u2hw56.raw: 'A sail with nothing left to push it. Comes down next to things about to fall over. Five cowries. I\'m stood well back.'
0u2hw56.text: A sail with nothing left to push it. Comes down next to things about to fall over. Five cowries. I'm stood well back.

113i66y.raw: 'Down hot from very high, shut like a clam. Opens for a friend and closes behind them. Four cowries. Not my friend.'
113i66y.text: Down hot from very high, shut like a clam. Opens for a friend and closes behind them. Four cowries. Not my friend.

1e1cwdf.raw: 'And the part that falls off first. Falls off things on purpose now. Keep it off the roof. Three cowries. The roof\'s on you.'
1e1cwdf.text: And the part that falls off first. Falls off things on purpose now. Keep it off the roof. Three cowries. The roof's on you.

1k6x444.raw: 'Off the Dropfield. Points its face at whoever spoke last and says it back louder. Five cowries. FIVE COWRIES.'
1k6x444.text: Off the Dropfield. Points its face at whoever spoke last and says it back louder. Five cowries. FIVE COWRIES.

16xu0ba.raw: 'Hull scrap fused into one lump, one eye bigger than the other. Runs hot and has to sit down. Three cowries. I know the feeling.'
16xu0ba.text: Hull scrap fused into one lump, one eye bigger than the other. Runs hot and has to sit down. Three cowries. I know the feeling.

00fi6jo.raw: 'A musk ox\'s cast, left standing in the snow. Eyes down by its knees. Frost on whatever it looks at. I ask four cowries, from behind it.'
00fi6jo.text: A musk ox's cast, left standing in the snow. Eyes down by its knees. Frost on whatever it looks at. I ask four cowries, from behind it.

1jmlrc5.raw: 'Plus a block that walked off the glacier. Stand still near it and your boots freeze to the floor. Pay the four cowries on the move.'
1jmlrc5.text: Plus a block that walked off the glacier. Stand still near it and your boots freeze to the floor. Pay the four cowries on the move.

102okwa.raw: 'What a seal-woman left on the ice. Somebody hid it in a chest once. Sleeps where it likes now. Five cowries. Don\'t tell her husband.'
102okwa.text: What a seal-woman left on the ice. Somebody hid it in a chest once. Sleeps where it likes now. Five cowries. Don't tell her husband.

1yp42wt.raw: 'Tusks growing up instead of down. Every third punch it throws is the one people talk about. Three cowries. People talk.'
1yp42wt.text: Tusks growing up instead of down. Every third punch it throws is the one people talk about. Three cowries. People talk.

0ybr6hu.raw: 'Off the shelf. Most of it under the ice, face and all. Five cowries for the top. The rest is extra.'
0ybr6hu.text: Off the shelf. Most of it under the ice, face and all. Five cowries for the top. The rest is extra.

167r280.raw: 'Which waits under the shelf lining its tusk up on you. The longer it waits the worse. Four cowries, before it\'s lined up.'
167r280.text: Which waits under the shelf lining its tusk up on you. The longer it waits the worse. Four cowries, before it's lined up.

0zfd9ba.raw: 'Off the eaves of a house, an icicle that fell in love with whoever lived there and came to life over it. Three cowries. It still melts a little when they pass.'
0zfd9ba.text: Off the eaves of a house, an icicle that fell in love with whoever lived there and came to life over it. Three cowries. It still melts a little when they pass.

1ko0axr.raw: 'Off the last pair of great auks, gone in my grandfather\'s time. Their shells kept going. Six cowries, and I\'d rather you kept it.'
1ko0axr.text: Off the last pair of great auks, gone in my grandfather's time. Their shells kept going. Six cowries, and I'd rather you kept it.

1jt1shf.raw: 'A soldier\'s breastplate, off the Hilt road. Face where the heart went. Every dent makes it harder to dent, and dearer. Four cowries today.'
1jt1shf.text: A soldier's breastplate, off the Hilt road. Face where the heart went. Every dent makes it harder to dent, and dearer. Four cowries today.

13zkspl.raw: 'And a battle banner, pole for a backbone. Snaps once before it does anything. Hand it three cowries and it snaps at those too.'
13zkspl.text: And a battle banner, pole for a backbone. Snaps once before it does anything. Hand it three cowries and it snaps at those too.

1gh72wb.raw: 'The half of a sword that stays in the grip. Spins when it\'s cornered. Five cowries for half a sword. The other half\'s dearer.'
1gh72wb.text: The half of a sword that stays in the grip. Spins when it's cornered. Five cowries for half a sword. The other half's dearer.

10dqiwf.raw: 'A round shield, one eye where the boss should be. Counts the blows it takes and pays each one back. Four cowries. Honest, that.'
10dqiwf.text: A round shield, one eye where the boss should be. Counts the blows it takes and pays each one back. Four cowries. Honest, that.

1xaoz48.raw: 'Plus a war horse with the barding still on. Throw it and it gets up and climbs back on itself. Five cowries and a brush.'
1xaoz48.text: Plus a war horse with the barding still on. Throw it and it gets up and climbs back on itself. Five cowries and a brush.

042noqv.raw: 'A catapult, arm growing out of its head. Throws what it catches and gets bigger as it goes. Five cowries. Stand behind it to pay.'
042noqv.text: A catapult, arm growing out of its head. Throws what it catches and gets bigger as it goes. Five cowries. Stand behind it to pay.

19ah01i.raw: 'A helmet on two short legs, from the battlefield. Some days there\'s a drake in it. Five cowries, more on drake days.'
19ah01i.text: A helmet on two short legs, from the battlefield. Some days there's a drake in it. Five cowries, more on drake days.

0iotyc1.raw: 'An arrow that never came down. Sits in the quiver and comes out sharper. Four cowries. Somebody\'s still waiting under it.'
0iotyc1.text: An arrow that never came down. Sits in the quiver and comes out sharper. Four cowries. Somebody's still waiting under it.

1v80h5t.raw: 'Which is a reflection the lakebed kept when the moon\'s shell rose. Does what you were about to do. Six cowries. You were about to pay.'
1v80h5t.text: Which is a reflection the lakebed kept when the moon's shell rose. Does what you were about to do. Six cowries. You were about to pay.

1j9rcc7.raw: 'A mudskipper. Hops when you look at it. Something bigger follows it about in the mud. Three cowries, and I\'m not asking what.'
1j9rcc7.text: A mudskipper. Hops when you look at it. Something bigger follows it about in the mud. Three cowries, and I'm not asking what.

1p3ns1t.raw: 'Silt off the Moonwater\'s bed, eyes at the bottom. You go in to the ankles and stop. I\'m asking three cowries, from dry ground.'
1p3ns1t.text: Silt off the Moonwater's bed, eyes at the bottom. You go in to the ankles and stop. I'm asking three cowries, from dry ground.

0wyn1nf.raw: 'And a frog with its mouth on its belly. Turns other things into frogs for a while. Three cowries. I was a frog Tuesday.'
0wyn1nf.text: And a frog with its mouth on its belly. Turns other things into frogs for a while. Three cowries. I was a frog Tuesday.

06jeqkp.raw: 'Off the moon\'s shell, a piece that broke on the way up. Throws its edges about and they come back. Six cowries. Mine didn\'t.'
06jeqkp.text: Off the moon's shell, a piece that broke on the way up. Throws its edges about and they come back. Six cowries. Mine didn't.

0hcmoup.raw: 'An iron stone off the fallen star. Walk past it and your buckles try to stay. Five cowries, and whatever buckles it keeps.'
0hcmoup.text: An iron stone off the fallen star. Walk past it and your buckles try to stay. Five cowries, and whatever buckles it keeps.

19vujuo.raw: 'Plus furnace slag with a brew going in it. Sell it on before the brew goes off. Four cowries. I\'m selling it on.'
19vujuo.text: Plus furnace slag with a brew going in it. Sell it on before the brew goes off. Four cowries. I'm selling it on.

13g607m.raw: 'Off the glass desert, broken. Holds whatever it grips until both of you stop. Five cowries, handed over in gloves.'
13g607m.text: Off the glass desert, broken. Holds whatever it grips until both of you stop. Five cowries, handed over in gloves.

0g6f5dc.raw: 'Plus the tail end of a scorpion. Walks on the sting and keeps the rest up top. Five cowries. Don\'t shake on it.'
0g6f5dc.text: Plus the tail end of a scorpion. Walks on the sting and keeps the rest up top. Five cowries. Don't shake on it.

1jmtx1a.raw: 'A jumping cactus. It does jump. Pull one joint out and another\'s already in. Four cowries, which it jumped at.'
1jmtx1a.text: A jumping cactus. It does jump. Pull one joint out and another's already in. Four cowries, which it jumped at.

1qv1cgb.raw: 'Which is a dune, with a dead reef in it. Comes up the road at night and stops at the door. Buds little ones. Four cowries, and two shovels.'
1qv1cgb.text: Which is a dune, with a dead reef in it. Comes up the road at night and stops at the door. Buds little ones. Four cowries, and two shovels.

1ip1ib0.raw: 'The wobble over hot glass, left behind. Keeps three weathers in its mouth and mixes them. Six cowries. Mixing\'s free.'
1ip1ib0.text: The wobble over hot glass, left behind. Keeps three weathers in its mouth and mixes them. Six cowries. Mixing's free.

1cys8z3.raw: 'A desert skull, bleached white as nacre. Gets up once more than you\'d think. Five cowries. Then once more.'
1cys8z3.text: A desert skull, bleached white as nacre. Gets up once more than you'd think. Five cowries. Then once more.

0d3j3nr.raw: 'Off the Hands\' orchard, pruning shears, eye in the pivot. Picks one branch and cuts only that one. Six cowries. Tidy.'
0d3j3nr.text: Off the Hands' orchard, pruning shears, eye in the pivot. Picks one branch and cuts only that one. Six cowries. Tidy.

0wgss5m.raw: 'And a gardener\'s glove, face in the palm. Throws itself at a friend and the friend lands swinging. Five cowries. No pairs.'
0wgss5m.text: And a gardener's glove, face in the palm. Throws itself at a friend and the friend lands swinging. Five cowries. No pairs.

0xyjmfa.raw: 'A grafted branch. Takes after whichever tree it beats first. Six cowries. Grafton would charge seven.'
0xyjmfa.text: A grafted branch. Takes after whichever tree it beats first. Six cowries. Grafton would charge seven.

0358jer.raw: 'A pear tree trained flat on the orchard wall. Lives on the wall and feeds whoever leans there. Six cowries, pears free.'
0358jer.text: A pear tree trained flat on the orchard wall. Lives on the wall and feeds whoever leans there. Six cowries, pears free.

1bdvo7j.raw: 'Plus a rung off a ladder on the Climb. Every turn it takes, it\'s a step higher. Six cowries on the bottom step.'
1bdvo7j.text: Plus a rung off a ladder on the Climb. Every turn it takes, it's a step higher. Six cowries on the bottom step.

0e88asa.raw: 'A blank off the edge where nothing was. Hit it and every one of you feels it. Seven cowries for nothing. Bargain.'
0e88asa.text: A blank off the edge where nothing was. Hit it and every one of you feels it. Seven cowries for nothing. Bargain.

06l4yd2.raw: 'The end of a road. Things that reach it stay. Charges at the barrier. Seven cowries, and that\'s the end of it.'
06l4yd2.text: The end of a road. Things that reach it stay. Charges at the barrier. Seven cowries, and that's the end of it.

0zz8lu7.raw: 'Which has its stars still going round it, this horizon. They fall when it asks. Seven cowries. Never asks me.'
0zz8lu7.text: Which has its stars still going round it, this horizon. They fall when it asks. Seven cowries. Never asks me.

17r24en.raw: 'Off the tide at the edge, the fog. Cuts deepest at whoever hasn\'t touched it yet. Seven cowries. Touch it first.'
17r24en.text: Off the tide at the edge, the fog. Cuts deepest at whoever hasn't touched it yet. Seven cowries. Touch it first.

0cloreo.raw: 'Out past the edge, something drowned. This is the part that fits in the Register. Seven cowries for this part. Rest on request.'
0cloreo.text: Out past the edge, something drowned. This is the part that fits in the Register. Seven cowries for this part. Rest on request.

0txhm6d.raw: 'And a piece of the Lip that walked off. Pulls things over the edge and gets heavier. Seven cowries by weight. Today\'s weight.'
0txhm6d.text: And a piece of the Lip that walked off. Pulls things over the edge and gets heavier. Seven cowries by weight. Today's weight.

1dhs2mg.raw: 'Off the Shallows, a wrinkle in loose ground. Step on one corner and the other corners come up. Six cowries. I\'d iron it.'
1dhs2mg.text: Off the Shallows, a wrinkle in loose ground. Step on one corner and the other corners come up. Six cowries. I'd iron it.

17q56lx.raw: 'And a dip in the Shallows that fills with salt water from below. Lays down mud in layers and wears them. Six cowries, muddy.'
17q56lx.text: And a dip in the Shallows that fills with salt water from below. Lays down mud in layers and wears them. Six cowries, muddy.

0uzlbc2.raw: 'A craze that got up out of the ground and walked off. Sets a ring of thorns on whoever follows. Seven cowries. Walk beside it.'
0uzlbc2.text: A craze that got up out of the ground and walked off. Sets a ring of thorns on whoever follows. Seven cowries. Walk beside it.

1ybzj6m.raw: 'Off the outside of the Volute, a barnacle. Lived on your world its whole life and never once looked in. Two cowries, no questions.'
1ybzj6m.text: Off the outside of the Volute, a barnacle. Lived on your world its whole life and never once looked in. Two cowries, no questions.

1speds0.raw: 'Was the Volute\'s lip, till the shell grew past it one spring. So it got up and left. Three cowries. Still thinks it\'s a lip.'
1speds0.text: Was the Volute's lip, till the shell grew past it one spring. So it got up and left. Three cowries. Still thinks it's a lip.

07mjv5h.raw: 'A gull. Forty years it rode the same air up the Volute every evening. Still goes up at six, indoors too. Two cowries, ceiling extra.'
07mjv5h.text: A gull. Forty years it rode the same air up the Volute every evening. Still goes up at six, indoors too. Two cowries, ceiling extra.

0bo49a0.raw: 'Which is spray, dried on the Volute\'s outside, square in every grain. I counted the grains. Two cowries, plus a week of counting.'
0bo49a0.text: Which is spray, dried on the Volute's outside, square in every grain. I counted the grains. Two cowries, plus a week of counting.

1jfl9pu.raw: 'Sand hopper, size of a dog. Jumps at shadows and lands on them, so keep yours still. One cowrie. My shadow\'s still sore.'
1jfl9pu.text: Sand hopper, size of a dog. Jumps at shadows and lands on them, so keep yours still. One cowrie. My shadow's still sore.

0qc5f6w.raw: 'Off the tide line, wrack weed that pops. Children buy it to hear it pop. One cowrie, and it won\'t pop for anyone who\'s turned.'
0qc5f6w.text: Off the tide line, wrack weed that pops. Children buy it to hear it pop. One cowrie, and it won't pop for anyone who's turned.

1gwipfi.raw: 'A crate. Floated in shut, stayed shut. I made a good offer for what\'s inside and it did not open. Rude. Three cowries, contents unknown.'
1gwipfi.text: A crate. Floated in shut, stayed shut. I made a good offer for what's inside and it did not open. Rude. Three cowries, contents unknown.

1269tp1.raw: 'Which is fallen star, a grain the size of a fist. Warm on one side, and the side keeps moving round. Four cowries. Bring tongs.'
1269tp1.text: Which is fallen star, a grain the size of a fist. Warm on one side, and the side keeps moving round. Four cowries. Bring tongs.

14ufc8d.raw: 'Plus a bottle. Broke on the wrack, got rubbed frosty by salt, then walked off. Two cowries. Sharp end\'s the front, so hold the back.'
14ufc8d.text: Plus a bottle. Broke on the wrack, got rubbed frosty by salt, then walked off. Two cowries. Sharp end's the front, so hold the back.

0tk1whc.raw: 'Fish, dried and salted on the wrack line by nobody. Who salts a fish for nobody? Very dry. One cowrie, which is more than nobody charged.'
0tk1whc.text: Fish, dried and salted on the wrack line by nobody. Who salts a fish for nobody? Very dry. One cowrie, which is more than nobody charged.

13ewgsx.raw: 'Tide-pool flower. Shuts tight when a shadow goes over, which out here is always. Shut now. Two cowries, sold shut.'
13ewgsx.text: Tide-pool flower. Shuts tight when a shadow goes over, which out here is always. Shut now. Two cowries, sold shut.

0wsr5cn.raw: 'Was a hollow in the sand where a taken shell lay. Goes round looking for the shell. Hasn\'t found it. Three cowries. It checks pockets.'
0wsr5cn.text: Was a hollow in the sand where a taken shell lay. Goes round looking for the shell. Hasn't found it. Three cowries. It checks pockets.

0fnvlpc.raw: 'One of the five doves out of a sand dollar. Flies only at night and brings things back. Four cowries, or whatever it brought you.'
0fnvlpc.text: One of the five doves out of a sand dollar. Flies only at night and brings things back. Four cowries, or whatever it brought you.

1go2k1j.raw: 'And the curl of sand a worm pushes up at low water. Worm left. Curl keeps curling. One cowrie. The worm\'s extra, if found.'
1go2k1j.text: And the curl of sand a worm pushes up at low water. Worm left. Curl keeps curling. One cowrie. The worm's extra, if found.

08zasg1.raw: 'Razor clam. Digs straight down whenever a star lands near it, which out here is every night. Three cowries, if you can dig it up.'
08zasg1.text: Razor clam. Digs straight down whenever a star lands near it, which out here is every night. Three cowries, if you can dig it up.

095ht0p.raw: 'The ring of light a landed star leaves on wet sand! Never faded, this one. Five cowries. You won\'t sleep with it in the room.'
095ht0p.text: The ring of light a landed star leaves on wet sand! Never faded, this one. Five cowries. You won't sleep with it in the room.

04b1eis.raw: 'Off the Cowrie\'s dome, one of the dark spots. Moves when nobody looks up. I\'ve never seen it move, so it\'s honest. Three cowries.'
04b1eis.text: Off the Cowrie's dome, one of the dark spots. Moves when nobody looks up. I've never seen it move, so it's honest. Three cowries.

11600uh.raw: 'The soft cover a cowrie slides over its shell. Polishes whatever it lies on. Three slippery cowries.'
11600uh.text: The soft cover a cowrie slides over its shell. Polishes whatever it lies on. Three slippery cowries.

07fl0il.raw: 'Wave. Stopped on the sand, stood up gray, and has stood there since my grandfather. Four cowries. Won\'t move for you, either.'
07fl0il.text: Wave. Stopped on the sand, stood up gray, and has stood there since my grandfather. Four cowries. Won't move for you, either.

1lee2sn.raw: 'Spray blown off a wave. The wave stopped. The spray didn\'t, and still hasn\'t. Two cowries, paid at a run.'
1lee2sn.text: Spray blown off a wave. The wave stopped. The spray didn't, and still hasn't. Two cowries, paid at a run.

0n358mk.raw: 'Which is the top coat of the Cowrie\'s polish, come off in one sheet and stood up. Three cowries. Shows every fingerprint.'
0n358mk.text: Which is the top coat of the Cowrie's polish, come off in one sheet and stood up. Three cowries. Shows every fingerprint.

1g2lvut.raw: 'Pig! Small, round, glazed all over, kept by the Cowrie folk. Rolls when the floor tilts, and the floor tilts. Two cowries. You chase it.'
1g2lvut.text: Pig! Small, round, glazed all over, kept by the Cowrie folk. Rolls when the floor tilts, and the floor tilts. Two cowries. You chase it.

0ko2cnr.raw: 'Purse of tiny cowries that grew shut. Clinks when pleased. Pricing money in money gives me a headache. Five cowries, or one of itself.'
0ko2cnr.text: Purse of tiny cowries that grew shut. Clinks when pleased. Pricing money in money gives me a headache. Five cowries, or one of itself.

1i7t85b.raw: 'Grit the Cowrie folk polish with. Scours whatever touches it, the hand included. Two cowries. Pay with the other hand.'
1i7t85b.text: Grit the Cowrie folk polish with. Scours whatever touches it, the hand included. Two cowries. Pay with the other hand.

0guhbj3.raw: 'Out of a Cowrie window box, a flower that grew glazed. Rings when touched. Ting! That was me. Three cowries a flower, tings free.'
0guhbj3.text: Out of a Cowrie window box, a flower that grew glazed. Rings when touched. Ting! That was me. Three cowries a flower, tings free.

0gfil0m.raw: 'Three of the Cowrie\'s teeth, still meshing on nothing. They\'ll mesh on you if you let them. Sleeves up, then hand me two cowries.'
0gfil0m.text: Three of the Cowrie's teeth, still meshing on nothing. They'll mesh on you if you let them. Sleeves up, then hand me two cowries.

02omz0z.raw: 'The gap between two of the Cowrie\'s teeth. Wandered off, and the teeth closed up behind it. Four cowries, which is a lot for a gap.'
02omz0z.text: The gap between two of the Cowrie's teeth. Wandered off, and the teeth closed up behind it. Four cowries, which is a lot for a gap.

1fcac5z.raw: 'Plus the rolled-in edge of the Cowrie\'s mouth. Keeps rolling in. Comes out quick. Two cowries, quicker than you.'
1fcac5z.text: Plus the rolled-in edge of the Cowrie's mouth. Keeps rolling in. Comes out quick. Two cowries, quicker than you.

0u293hf.raw: 'A reflection. Fell three steps behind its owner and never caught up. Does what you did. Four cowries, paid three steps ago.'
0u293hf.text: A reflection. Fell three steps behind its owner and never caught up. Does what you did. Four cowries, paid three steps ago.

1sp1hr2.raw: 'Back of a mirror, the silver bit. Shows nothing on its own. Hold it up to me and it shows three cowries.'
1sp1hr2.text: Back of a mirror, the silver bit. Shows nothing on its own. Hold it up to me and it shows three cowries.

1xaadgz.raw: 'Shine off the Cowrie\'s dome at full dark. Went off on its own one night. Four cowries. Outshines your lamp, out of spite.'
1xaadgz.text: Shine off the Cowrie's dome at full dark. Went off on its own one night. Four cowries. Outshines your lamp, out of spite.

0gbzs5d.raw: 'Plus wind. Went round and round inside the Auger so long it kept the shape. Sit down before you count out three cowries.'
0gbzs5d.text: Plus wind. Went round and round inside the Auger so long it kept the shape. Sit down before you count out three cowries.

0cbkuq2.raw: 'Lichen, off the Auger\'s outside. Moves round to the dry side every tide. Slow? Slow. One cowrie, delivered next year.'
0cbkuq2.text: Lichen, off the Auger's outside. Moves round to the dry side every tide. Slow? Slow. One cowrie, delivered next year.

0asfs7j.raw: 'Swell that lifted the Auger at high water and set it down again. Lifts things, prices too. Three cowries this morning. Four now.'
0asfs7j.text: Swell that lifted the Auger at high water and set it down again. Lifts things, prices too. Three cowries this morning. Four now.

10cl4la.raw: 'White dust a climber kept in a pouch, till it climbed out of the pouch. Two cowries, and it\'ll climb out of yours.'
10cl4la.text: White dust a climber kept in a pouch, till it climbed out of the pouch. Two cowries, and it'll climb out of yours.

1c9ee4v.raw: 'Which is the white line the tide leaves on the Auger\'s walls, a little higher every roll. Three cowries and rising.'
1c9ee4v.text: Which is the white line the tide leaves on the Auger's walls, a little higher every roll. Three cowries and rising.

0asmhbe.raw: 'Weed. Rolls round the Auger\'s rooms and never roots. Came in my front door and out the back without buying a thing. One cowrie.'
0asmhbe.text: Weed. Rolls round the Auger's rooms and never roots. Came in my front door and out the back without buying a thing. One cowrie.

1ct4ptw.raw: 'One step off the Auger\'s stair. Stand on it and up it goes, by itself. Three cowries, going up.'
1ct4ptw.text: One step off the Auger's stair. Stand on it and up it goes, by itself. Three cowries, going up.

0yvmuzm.raw: 'The post down the middle of the Auger. Climbed itself! Everything leans on it, me included. Five cowries, and it leans back.'
0yvmuzm.text: The post down the middle of the Auger. Climbed itself! Everything leans on it, me included. Five cowries, and it leans back.

10wo73u.raw: 'Handhold, worn into the wall by sixty years of fingers till it went finger-shaped. Two cowries. Hold it gently, it\'s tired.'
10wo73u.text: Handhold, worn into the wall by sixty years of fingers till it went finger-shaped. Two cowries. Hold it gently, it's tired.

13vejc0.raw: 'Goat! The climbers kept it. Climbs walls sideways, still. Two cowries, plus whatever it\'s standing on.'
13vejc0.text: Goat! The climbers kept it. Climbs walls sideways, still. Two cowries, plus whatever it's standing on.

04zp6u7.raw: 'Swift that nested at the top of the Auger and never landed any lower. Sells for three cowries, up a ladder.'
04zp6u7.text: Swift that nested at the top of the Auger and never landed any lower. Sells for three cowries, up a ladder.

1wsbt4u.raw: 'The push of air in the Auger\'s narrow whorls. Got a shell and kept pushing. Two cowries. It\'ll push for one.'
1wsbt4u.text: The push of air in the Auger's narrow whorls. Got a shell and kept pushing. Two cowries. It'll push for one.

1qxyjp4.raw: 'The drop under the top stair. Kept falling after nobody did, and is falling now. Drop four cowries in and listen for them.'
1qxyjp4.text: The drop under the top stair. Kept falling after nobody did, and is falling now. Drop four cowries in and listen for them.

1xaayog.raw: 'Highest point the Auger ever pointed at. Points at it still. Up. That way. The five cowries go this way.'
1xaayog.text: Highest point the Auger ever pointed at. Points at it still. Up. That way. The five cowries go this way.

0v59alw.raw: 'Low note the Auger plays when air goes through it. This one kept humming, on my shelf, all night. Three cowries. Please.'
0v59alw.text: Low note the Auger plays when air goes through it. This one kept humming, on my shelf, all night. Three cowries. Please.

1qlpdts.raw: 'Which is the hole the star burned through the Margin! Opens wherever it\'s put. Six cowries. Mine\'s on the floor. Can\'t find the floor.'
1qlpdts.text: Which is the hole the star burned through the Margin! Opens wherever it's put. Six cowries. Mine's on the floor. Can't find the floor.

0sv8b0u.raw: 'Moon snail. Drills a round hole in anything and goes in. Drilled my cowries, the little button. Six cowries. Three, with a hole in.'
0sv8b0u.text: Moon snail. Drills a round hole in anything and goes in. Drilled my cowries, the little button. Six cowries. Three, with a hole in.

16g37pi.raw: 'Bird. Flew over the whole beach once and never came down. Its shell came down. Seven cowries. The bird\'s still up there if you want it.'
16g37pi.text: Bird. Flew over the whole beach once and never came down. Its shell came down. Seven cowries. The bird's still up there if you want it.

1j57ejw.raw: 'The Nautilus\'s first room, size of a pea. Grew a shell of its own and is still growing. Six cowries today. Bigger tomorrow.'
1j57ejw.text: The Nautilus's first room, size of a pea. Grew a shell of its own and is still growing. Six cowries today. Bigger tomorrow.

0zgzj7x.raw: 'Gran\'s cast. Came out in my bundle, on top of the cowries. No price. I carried her. I never bought her, and I\'d not sell her.'
0zgzj7x.text: Gran's cast. Came out in my bundle, on top of the cowries. No price. I carried her. I never bought her, and I'd not sell her.

0awgoyb.raw: 'Kelp off the Low Line. Stands up when the sea goes out. Lies down again when you sit near it, out of manners. Manners cost two cowries.'
0awgoyb.text: Kelp off the Low Line. Stands up when the sea goes out. Lies down again when you sit near it, out of manners. Manners cost two cowries.

010pzdz.raw: 'Patch of sea meadow with a face in it! Step on it and it lies flat and slows your foot. Two cowries, foot back by supper.'
010pzdz.text: Patch of sea meadow with a face in it! Step on it and it lies flat and slows your foot. Two cowries, foot back by supper.

0c46kzl.raw: 'Up from a depth with no light in it, both eyes on top of its head. Stares at the sky the whole time. Three cowries. Won\'t look at money.'
0c46kzl.text: Up from a depth with no light in it, both eyes on top of its head. Stares at the sky the whole time. Three cowries. Won't look at money.

1qyql87.raw: 'Says it fell from the sky. Has told me so at every market for six years. Two cowries, whatever it says.'
1qyql87.text: Says it fell from the sky. Has told me so at every market for six years. Two cowries, whatever it says.

02ycnty.raw: 'One arm off a nautilus. Let go and kept reaching, and hasn\'t found anything to hold yet. Three cowries. It\'s been reaching for my purse.'
02ycnty.text: One arm off a nautilus. Let go and kept reaching, and hasn't found anything to hold yet. Three cowries. It's been reaching for my purse.

0qqpemg.raw: 'Plus the jet a nautilus breathes out. Breathes other things away from it, mostly my stall. Two cowries. Pay from over there.'
0qqpemg.text: Plus the jet a nautilus breathes out. Breathes other things away from it, mostly my stall. Two cowries. Pay from over there.

0vc6k54.raw: 'The still minute between tides, in a shell. Nothing near it moves. Sold one once, and the buyer\'s still standing there. Four cowries.'
0vc6k54.text: The still minute between tides, in a shell. Nothing near it moves. Sold one once, and the buyer's still standing there. Four cowries.

0xcqa4s.raw: 'Finger of cold brine that froze its way to the sea floor. Points down. Always right about down. Hand me three cowries, mittens on.'
0xcqa4s.text: Finger of cold brine that froze its way to the sea floor. Points down. Always right about down. Hand me three cowries, mittens on.

04dbhbm.raw: 'The night a star crossed the moon, kept and played back. Twice, if you watch. Four cowries, both showings.'
04dbhbm.text: The night a star crossed the moon, kept and played back. Twice, if you watch. Four cowries, both showings.

1s6s35d.raw: 'Which is stones the Nautilus folk carried to sink a room. They sink on their own now. Three cowries. Weigh it before you pay, and after.'
1s6s35d.text: Which is stones the Nautilus folk carried to sink a room. They sink on their own now. Three cowries. Weigh it before you pay, and after.

0s45zx4.raw: 'Gate, between two Nautilus rooms. Lets one side through and never says which. Three cowries, or the other side of three.'
0s45zx4.text: Gate, between two Nautilus rooms. Lets one side through and never says which. Three cowries, or the other side of three.

09uiq55.raw: 'A wall from inside the Nautilus. Seals behind whatever walks past it, so I walk round it, the long way. Three cowries. Don\'t go first.'
09uiq55.text: A wall from inside the Nautilus. Seals behind whatever walks past it, so I walk round it, the long way. Three cowries. Don't go first.

0obxyps.raw: 'Air from a sealed room, kept so long it got a shell. Smells of the year the room was shut. Good year. Two cowries.'
0obxyps.text: Air from a sealed room, kept so long it got a shell. Smells of the year the room was shut. Good year. Two cowries.

1l5t0nc.raw: 'Salt left in rings where a room of water dried. Takes a ring off whatever stands in it. Three cowries, minus a ring.'
1l5t0nc.text: Salt left in rings where a room of water dried. Takes a ring off whatever stands in it. Three cowries, minus a ring.

1vlf0m3.raw: 'The hood a nautilus shuts its door with. Shuts any door. Mine hasn\'t opened since! Writing this through the window. Four cowries.'
1vlf0m3.text: The hood a nautilus shuts its door with. Shuts any door. Mine hasn't opened since! Writing this through the window. Four cowries.

008o8je.raw: 'One of the Gleaner\'s footprints, long as a house. Stars land in it on purpose. Three cowries a footprint. The foot\'s not mine to sell.'
008o8je.text: One of the Gleaner's footprints, long as a house. Stars land in it on purpose. Three cowries a footprint. The foot's not mine to sell.

1jcf3d2.raw: 'Star that came down bright at a spring low and kept burning. Not in your pocket! Four cowries, and a new pocket.'
1jcf3d2.text: Star that came down bright at a spring low and kept burning. Not in your pocket! Four cowries, and a new pocket.

1cexk69.raw: 'Dune grass. Its roots hold the Long Strand together, and one root walked off, and this is it. Two cowries. The Strand wants it back.'
1cexk69.text: Dune grass. Its roots hold the Long Strand together, and one root walked off, and this is it. Two cowries. The Strand wants it back.

04zauqt.raw: 'Crisp salt plant off the foot of a label post. Spits, and salt piles up on whatever it hits. Two cowries a pinch.'
04zauqt.text: Crisp salt plant off the foot of a label post. Spits, and salt piles up on whatever it hits. Two cowries a pinch.

0d5cbuc.raw: 'White glare off a salt flat at night. Look at it and you see less of everything else, the price included. Three cowries.'
0d5cbuc.text: White glare off a salt flat at night. Look at it and you see less of everything else, the price included. Three cowries.

0mnwdpv.raw: 'Cuttlefish bone. Matches whatever it lies by. Matched my counter a week before I found it. Three cowries. It\'s on the counter. Somewhere.'
0mnwdpv.text: Cuttlefish bone. Matches whatever it lies by. Matched my counter a week before I found it. Three cowries. It's on the counter. Somewhere.

1y6llgx.raw: 'A jelly the spring low left. Ripples when anyone talks near it, so I am writing this one very quietly. Three cowries.'
1y6llgx.text: A jelly the spring low left. Ripples when anyone talks near it, so I am writing this one very quietly. Three cowries.

1c8qh2o.raw: 'And a white post, off the corner of a slot in the Tray. Stands where it\'s put and nowhere else. Four cowries, so put it somewhere good.'
1c8qh2o.text: And a white post, off the corner of a slot in the Tray. Stands where it's put and nowhere else. Four cowries, so put it somewhere good.

1m8t8h2.raw: 'Label post. Walks to the nearest shell and stands in front of it. In front of me since Tuesday. Three cowries. Hasn\'t written anything yet.'
1m8t8h2.text: Label post. Walks to the nearest shell and stands in front of it. In front of me since Tuesday. Three cowries. Hasn't written anything yet.

06tt1qb.raw: 'An empty slot from the Tray, still waiting for its shell. Square, and expecting. It expects four cowries off you, at least.'
06tt1qb.text: An empty slot from the Tray, still waiting for its shell. Square, and expecting. It expects four cowries off you, at least.

1g2q3wg.raw: 'Top shell from a world in the Tray. Spins when nobody watches, so I sell it with my eyes shut. Three cowries. Count your change by feel.'
1g2q3wg.text: Top shell from a world in the Tray. Spins when nobody watches, so I sell it with my eyes shut. Three cowries. Count your change by feel.

1o698t4.raw: 'Hollow salt crystal, stepped inward like a stair. Every step goes in and none come out. Three cowries go in. None come out.'
1o698t4.text: Hollow salt crystal, stepped inward like a stair. Every step goes in and none come out. Three cowries go in. None come out.

0ey7y4e.raw: 'Crab, crusted white with salt. Walks between the slots and never into one. Sideways about the price, too. Three cowries.'
0ey7y4e.text: Crab, crusted white with salt. Walks between the slots and never into one. Sideways about the price, too. Three cowries.

1hccnfw.raw: 'Took one of everything from the Tray and keeps it all under its wings. Took one of my cowries too. Four cowries, so five, really.'
1hccnfw.text: Took one of everything from the Tray and keeps it all under its wings. Took one of my cowries too. Four cowries, so five, really.

05ycdjq.raw: 'Hole where the Mudlark hides finds. Keeps whatever falls in, people included, for a while. Three cowries. I fell in. Lost an afternoon.'
05ycdjq.text: Hole where the Mudlark hides finds. Keeps whatever falls in, people included, for a while. Three cowries. I fell in. Lost an afternoon.

0febdcq.raw: 'Eye on a stalk, off a conch lip. Hasn\'t blinked in the three years I\'ve had it. Three cowries. I blink first, every time.'
0febdcq.text: Eye on a stalk, off a conch lip. Hasn't blinked in the three years I've had it. Three cowries. I blink first, every time.

03ngx1w.raw: 'Shore bird. Runs at the edge of every wave. Never been wet in its life. Two cowries, dry.'
03ngx1w.text: Shore bird. Runs at the edge of every wave. Never been wet in its life. Two cowries, dry.

0yqnkch.raw: 'Top of a high tide that came into the Conch and stayed. Wets whatever\'s lowest. Three cowries a puddle.'
0yqnkch.text: Top of a high tide that came into the Conch and stayed. Wets whatever's lowest. Three cowries a puddle.

0ks9w3j.raw: 'Sea sound from inside the Conch. Got out. Hold it to your ear and you hear a conch, which is backward. Three cowries, forward or backward.'
0ks9w3j.text: Sea sound from inside the Conch. Got out. Hold it to your ear and you hear a conch, which is backward. Three cowries, forward or backward.

1n13ia5.raw: 'Salt flower off the Conch\'s lip, where the spray dries. Dries whatever it touches the same way. Three cowries. My hands are still dry.'
1n13ia5.text: Salt flower off the Conch's lip, where the spray dries. Dries whatever it touches the same way. Three cowries. My hands are still dry.

0zxryez.raw: 'Coral, grown in the shape of a hand on the Conch\'s outside. Holds your hand back! Four cowries, if it lets go long enough to pay.'
0zxryez.text: Coral, grown in the shape of a hand on the Conch's outside. Holds your hand back! Four cowries, if it lets go long enough to pay.

0hkwq70.raw: 'Pink pearl that rolls toward voices. Say its price and it rolls to you. Four cowries! See? Here it comes.'
0hkwq70.text: Pink pearl that rolls toward voices. Say its price and it rolls to you. Four cowries! See? Here it comes.

1146zbf.raw: 'The spiral in the Conch where a sound goes in and comes out louder. Four cowries. I sneezed near it once and lost a window.'
1146zbf.text: The spiral in the Conch where a sound goes in and comes out louder. Four cowries. I sneezed near it once and lost a window.

0euc2n4.raw: 'Sea plant from the Conch\'s damp turns, crisp and salt. Pickles whatever it holds. Yours for three cowries, if you let go of them quick.'
0euc2n4.text: Sea plant from the Conch's damp turns, crisp and salt. Pickles whatever it holds. Yours for three cowries, if you let go of them quick.

1mgfe7u.raw: 'Ring in a ring. Keeps whatever sits in it level. Kept my tea level through a whole storm. Four cowries. The storm was free.'
1mgfe7u.text: Ring in a ring. Keeps whatever sits in it level. Kept my tea level through a whole storm. Four cowries. The storm was free.

0gqokmz.raw: 'The quiet in the Conch\'s mouth while the big one sleeps. Quiet in one particular way. Four cowries. Shh.'
0gqokmz.text: The quiet in the Conch's mouth while the big one sleeps. Quiet in one particular way. Four cowries. Shh.

0agovad.raw: 'The flared lip of the Conch. Opens wider when it hears its name, so in my shop it\'s called Plim. Four cowries, Plim.'
0agovad.text: The flared lip of the Conch. Opens wider when it hears its name, so in my shop it's called Plim. Four cowries, Plim.

057f8vd.raw: 'One of seven stars that fell together. Goes looking for the other six and finds one now and then. Four cowries. The set\'s more.'
057f8vd.text: One of seven stars that fell together. Goes looking for the other six and finds one now and then. Four cowries. The set's more.

11asujy.raw: 'Star that went out as far as it could and is on its way back. Quicker the closer it comes. Five cowries, and stand to one side.'
11asujy.text: Star that went out as far as it could and is on its way back. Quicker the closer it comes. Five cowries, and stand to one side.

022xoe8.raw: 'The Tide-reader\'s grandmother\'s brass star-measurer. Kept measuring after she stopped. Six cowries. It measured me. I\'m short.'
022xoe8.text: The Tide-reader's grandmother's brass star-measurer. Kept measuring after she stopped. Six cowries. It measured me. I'm short.

1sahg88.raw: 'Fallen star, green inside, caught in a shell before it touched sand. Shuts the shell again when it\'s hurt. Seven cowries, and worth eight.'
1sahg88.text: Fallen star, green inside, caught in a shell before it touched sand. Shuts the shell again when it's hurt. Seven cowries, and worth eight.

1tqjd7w.raw: 'Pink bloom off the saltiest pool on the Strand. Water it sits in turns the color of the Conch\'s lip. Six cowries, pink if you have them.'
1tqjd7w.text: Pink bloom off the saltiest pool on the Strand. Water it sits in turns the color of the Conch's lip. Six cowries, pink if you have them.

0dv37ru.raw: 'Oldest whorl in the Gleaner\'s Tray. Nobody knows what grew in it. Takes the best thing you have. Seven cowries, then your best thing.'
0dv37ru.text: Oldest whorl in the Gleaner's Tray. Nobody knows what grew in it. Takes the best thing you have. Seven cowries, then your best thing.

0uq7cr6.raw: 'The star the Gleaner walked by. Took it down and kept it. Still points the same way. Seven cowries. Don\'t ask it the way home.'
0uq7cr6.text: The star the Gleaner walked by. Took it down and kept it. Still points the same way. Seven cowries. Don't ask it the way home.

0ou5u7w.raw: 'Coiled shell from a beach that\'s gone. Won\'t move until you hit it. Then it gives it back! I\'d pay the six cowries without arguing.'
0ou5u7w.text: Coiled shell from a beach that's gone. Won't move until you hit it. Then it gives it back! I'd pay the six cowries without arguing.

03alop9.raw: 'The Gleaner, sitting. No price. I would not know whom to pay.'
03alop9.text: The Gleaner, sitting. No price. I would not know whom to pay.

1jwuy2l.raw: 'Off a neck nobody remembers, a collar of twelve settings. Sets its own stones now, in an order it keeps to itself. No price. It keeps setting my cowries.'
1jwuy2l.text: Off a neck nobody remembers, a collar of twelve settings. Sets its own stones now, in an order it keeps to itself. No price. It keeps setting my cowries.
